albums.description: 어둠을 뚫고 솟구쳐 오르는 열정과 따스한 위로를 담은 1집 (21곡)

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]
널 그려본다...
널 그려본다...
널 그려본다...
널 그려본다...

[Verse 1]
눈부시게 푸르던 계절의 끝에
아무 일 없다는 듯 바람은 불어와
아무 일 없다는 듯 바람은 불어와
모두가 웃으며 길을 걷는데
나만 홀로 멈춰 서서 널 그려본다

[Verse 2]
잊었다고 몇 번을 되뇌어 봐도
가슴 한구석 시린 통증이 번져
보내주려 할수록 깊어지는 맘
바보처럼 왜 난 아직 제자리일까

[Pre-Chorus]
너의 기억이 밀려오는 밤이면
심장이 찢길 듯이 아파와도
다시 너를 찾아 헤매는 내 발걸음

[Chorus]
날 선 비수가 되어 심장을 베어낸 너!
제발 날 놓아달라고 울부짖어도!
쏟아진 눈물 속에 네가 차올라!
죽을 만큼 사랑했던 나의 사람아!
너 없는 세상 속에 갇힌 채
홀로 울부짖는 내 마지막 사랑!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
계절이 바뀌고 세월이 흘러도
이 흉터는 아물지 않을 걸 알아
차라리 미워하며 살 수 있다면
이토록 가슴이 무너지진 않을 텐데

[Pre-Chorus]
차가운 바람이 내 뺨을 스치면
터질 듯 차오르는 그리움에
또다시 너의 이름을 부른다

[Chorus]
날 선 비수가 되어 심장을 베어낸 너!
제발 날 놓아달라고 울부짖어도!
쏟아진 눈물 속에 네가 차올라!
죽을 만큼 사랑했던 나의 사람아!
너 없는 세상 속에 갇힌 채
홀로 울부짖는 내 마지막 사랑!

[Bridge]

[Chorus]
차라리 내 숨을 거둬 날 데려가 줘!
가슴이 멎을 때까지 널 부르고 있어!
흉터로 남은 내 심장이 재가 되어도!
영원히 너만을 사랑해!
사랑한다 내 사랑아!

[Outro]
안녕... 나의 전부였던 너...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
I picture you in my mind...
I picture you in my mind...
I picture you in my mind...
I picture you in my mind...

[Verse 1]
At the edge of that blindingly blue season
The wind blows past as if nothing ever happened
The wind blows past as if nothing ever happened
While everyone walks by with smiles upon their faces
I alone stand still, picturing you in my mind

[Verse 2]
No matter how many times I say I've forgotten
A freezing ache spreads deep into my chest
The harder I try to let go, the deeper my longing grows
Like a fool, why am I still standing in the same place?

[Pre-Chorus]
Whenever nights bring the rushing waves of your memory
Even if my heart feels torn to pieces in pain
My wandering footsteps search for you once again

[Chorus]
You turned into a razor-sharp dagger that slashed my heart!
Even when I scream and beg you to let me go!
In these spilled tears, you keep rising back to life!
My love whom I loved to death!
Trapped inside a world without you
I scream alone, my last remaining love!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
Even as the seasons change and the years flow on
I know this scar will never truly heal
If only I could live on hating you instead
My heart wouldn't crumble down in ruins like this

[Pre-Chorus]
When the chilly wind brushes past my cheek
With longing bursting at the seams
I call out your name once again

[Chorus]
You turned into a razor-sharp dagger that slashed my heart!
Even when I scream and beg you to let me go!
In these spilled tears, you keep rising back to life!
My love whom I loved to death!
Trapped inside a world without you
I scream alone, my last remaining love!

[Bridge]

[Chorus]
Take my breath away instead and take me with you!
I'll keep calling your name until my heartbeat stops!
Even if my scarred heart burns away to ashes!
I will love only you forever!
I love you, my eternal love!

[Outro]
Goodbye... you who were my everything...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
차가운 계절의 틈 사이로
얼어붙은 거리를 홀로 걸어
모든 게 변해가는 세상 속에
나만 홀로 멈춘 줄 알았어

[Verse 2]
하지만 내 가슴 깊은 곳엔
아직 식지 않은 불씨 하나
고개를 들어 저 하늘을 봐
어둠 뒤엔 반드시 아침이 와

[Pre-Chorus]
바람이 불어와 옷깃을 스칠 때
우리가 나눈 약속이 떠올라
더는 주저하지 않아, 달려갈 거야

[Chorus]
우리의 계절은 결코 멈추지 않아!
시련의 언덕을 넘어 빛을 향해 달려!
넘어지고 부딪쳐 찢긴 상처마저
내일의 찬란한 훈장이 될 테니!
소리쳐 불러봐, 우리의 이름을!

[Bridge]
두려워 마, 손을 잡아
우리가 함께 걷는 이 길 위에
영원히 바래지 않을 빛이 내려

[Chorus]
찬란하게 타올라라, 우리의 오늘이여!
세상의 끝까지 멈추지 않을 노래!
가슴 터질 듯한 환희로 걸어가리라!
영원히 빛날 우리의 날들!

[Outro]
멈추지 않아... 바로 지금...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Through the cracks of this cold season
I walk alone down the frozen street
In a world where everything keeps changing
I thought I alone was standing still

[Verse 2]
Yet deep inside my chest
A burning ember that never died
Lift your head and look up at that sky
Behind the darkness, morning always comes

[Pre-Chorus]
When the wind sweeps past and brushes my collar
The promise we made comes back to mind
I won't hesitate any longer, I'm going to run

[Chorus]
Our season will never, ever stop!
Cross the hill of trials and sprint toward the light!
Even the wounds torn from stumbling and falling
Will become tomorrow's glorious badges of honor!
Shout it out loud, call our name!

[Bridge]
Don't be afraid, take my hand
Upon this road we walk together
A light that will never fade shines down on us

[Chorus]
Blaze brilliantly, our glorious today!
A song that will never stop until the end of the world!
We'll walk forward with hearts bursting with pure joy!
Our days that will shine forever!

[Outro]
Never stopping... right here, right now...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]
끈을 꽉 묶어!
쿵- 짝- 발을 구르며 소리쳐
더 이상 망설일 시간은 없어
쿵- 짝- 발을 구르며 소리쳐
더 이상 망설일 시간은 없어!

[Verse 1]
새벽 공기를 깊게 들이쉬고
낡은 운동화 끈을 꽉 묶어
어제까지의 무거운 고민들은
어둠 속에 훌훌 털어버려

[Pre-Chorus]
쿵- 짝- 발을 구르며 소리쳐
더 이상 망설일 시간은 없어
자, 지금 바로 출발이야!

[Chorus]
달려라, 푸른 새벽을 지나 햇살 속으로!
세상 모든 걱정은 바람에 날려 보내고!
너와 내가 함께 달리는 이 순간이
세상에서 가장 눈부신 축제야!
신나게 달려가자!

[Bridge]
하나, 둘, 셋, 힘차게 뛰어올라!
더 높이, 저 하늘 끝까지!
우리의 젊음은 지금부터야!

[Chorus]
끝없이 펼쳐진 저 푸른 길을 향해!
끝없이 펼쳐진 저 푸른 길을 향해!
멈추지 않는 우리들의 눈부신 행진!
태양보다 더 뜨겁게 타오르는 꿈!
영원히 잊지 못할 찬란한 오늘!

[Outro]
라-라-라-라-라 계속 달려가!
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
Tie your laces tight!
Boom-clap- stomp your feet and shout out loud
There's no more time to hesitate
Boom-clap- stomp your feet and shout out loud
There's no more time to hesitate!

[Verse 1]
Take a deep breath of the fresh dawn air
Tie the laces of your worn sneakers tight
All the heavy worries from yesterday
Shake them all off into the darkness

[Pre-Chorus]
Boom-clap- stomp your feet and shout out loud
There's no more time to hesitate
Come on, our journey begins right now!

[Chorus]
Run, pass through the blue dawn and into the sunlight!
Send all the worries of the world flying in the wind!
This very moment when you and I run together
Is the most dazzling festival on earth!
Let's run with all our joy!

[Bridge]
One, two, three, jump up high with all your might!
Even higher, up to the end of the sky!
Our youth starts right here, right now!

[Chorus]
Toward that endless blue road stretching ahead!
Toward that endless blue road stretching ahead!
Our unstoppable, dazzling parade!
A dream burning hotter than the sun!
A glorious today we'll never forget!

[Outro]
La-la-la-la-la keep on running!
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
어스름한 방 안, 창문 밖엔
하루를 마친 도시의 소음들
지친 어깨를 가만히 감싸 안고
따스한 차 한 잔을 내려놓네

[Verse 2]
말하지 않아도 다 알고 있어
오늘 하루도 참 고단했지
세상의 무게에 짓눌려 휘청여도
넌 오늘도 묵묵히 버텨냈어

[Pre-Chorus]
어둠이 아무리 깊고 차가워도
작은 불빛 하나만 있다면
우린 다시 길을 찾을 수 있어

[Chorus]
작은 불빛 하나 켜두고 누워
오늘 하루를 따스히 품어줘
참 잘해왔다고, 애썼다고
스스로에게 건네는 다정한 위로
밤하늘 별처럼 고요히 반짝여

[Bridge]
눈을 감으면 들려오는 숨소리
어떤 불안도 너를 흔들지 못해
편안히 잠들렴, 나의 소중한 사람

[Outro]
잘 자요, 따뜻한 꿈속으로...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Inside the dim twilight room, outside the window
The fading noises of the city finishing its day
Gently wrapping an arm around your tired shoulders
Placing down a warm cup of comforting tea

[Verse 2]
Even without words, I already know
Today was another truly exhausting day
Though you staggered under the heavy weight of the world
You quietly endured and pulled through once again

[Pre-Chorus]
No matter how deep and cold the darkness may be
As long as there is a single little glow
We can always find our way back home

[Chorus]
Leave a little light on and lie down softly
Embrace this day with gentle warmth
"You've done so well, you've tried so hard"
A tender comfort whispered to yourself
Shining quietly like a star in the midnight sky

[Bridge]
Close your eyes and listen to your gentle breath
No anxiety can ever shake you now
Rest and sleep in peace, my precious one

[Outro]
Good night, drift into warm and peaceful dreams...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
아침부터 커피를 쏟아버리고
눈앞에서 버스를 놓쳤더라도
괜스레 한숨 푹 내쉬지 마
그냥 그런 날도 있는 법이잖아

[Verse 2]
생각대로 흘러가지 않는 세상
다들 뭐가 그리 바쁜지 뛰어가지만
오늘은 나만의 속도로 걸어볼래
구름 모양이나 구경하면서

[Pre-Chorus]
잠깐 삐끗했다고 주저앉지 마
인생이란 원래 뜻밖의 여행인걸
자, 어깨를 활짝 펴고 웃어봐!

[Chorus]
괜찮아! 오늘 하루쯤은 넘어져도 돼!
완벽하지 않아도 넌 충분히 빛나!
잠깐 쉬어가는 정류장일 뿐이야
파란 하늘을 보며 기지개를 켜봐!
내일은 분명 더 멋진 날이 올 테니까!

[Bridge]
비가 내린 뒤엔 무지개가 뜨고
겨울이 지나면 반드시 꽃이 피어나
너의 미소가 세상을 바꿔줄 거야!

[Chorus]
웃어봐! 세상을 향해 윙크를 날려봐!
걱정 근심은 모조리 날려버리고!
너만의 리듬으로 춤추는 오늘!
세상에서 가장 행복한 주인공이 돼!

[Outro]
그래, 활짝 웃어봐! 바로 그렇게!
그래, 활짝 웃어봐! 바로 그렇게!
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Even if you spilled your coffee first thing in the morning
And missed the bus right in front of your eyes
Don't let out that heavy sigh
Some days just turn out that way, you know

[Verse 2]
In a world that never goes according to plan
Where everyone is running so busy and fast
Today, I'll walk at my very own easy pace
Admiring the shapes of clouds drifting above

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't collapse just because you stumbled for a moment
Life is meant to be an unexpected journey after all
Come on, pull your shoulders back and smile!

[Chorus]
It's okay! It's totally fine to fall down just for today!
Even if you're not perfect, you shine brightly enough!
It's just a little bus stop to catch your breath
Look up at the blue sky and stretch out wide!
Tomorrow will surely bring an even better day!

[Bridge]
After the rain falls, a rainbow always appears
After winter passes, blossoms will surely bloom
Your warm smile will change the entire world!

[Chorus]
Smile! Throw a cheeky wink toward the world!
Blow away every single worry and doubt!
Dancing to your own unique rhythm today!
You become the happiest star in the world!

[Outro]
Yes, smile wide and bright! Just like that!
Yes, smile wide and bright! Just like that!
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
차갑게 식어버린 너의 손을 잡고
끝내 전하지 못한 말을 삼킨다
세상이 우릴 갈라놓는다 해도
내 영혼은 오직 너만을 기억해

[Verse 2]
너를 위해 흘렸던 수많은 눈물
그 모든 방황의 끝은 너였어
이 모진 삶의 거친 폭풍 속에서
넌 나의 유일한 안식처였으니

[Pre-Chorus]
하늘이 나를 버린다 해도
지옥의 불길이 타오른대도
난 너의 곁을 지키리라!

[Chorus]
타올라라, 영원히 꺼지지 않을 사랑이여!
내 심장이 멎는 그 순간까지 널 부르리라!
어떤 어둠도 우릴 가로막지 못해!
내 모든 영혼을 바쳐 널 지켜낼 테니!
영원토록 너만을 사랑해!

[Bridge]
세상이 끝나더라도!
우리의 사랑은 살아 숨 쉬리라!

[Chorus]
내 목숨이 다하는 그날까지!
너 하나만을 품에 안고 살아가리라!
죽음마저 우릴 갈라놓지 못할!
찬란하게 불타오르는 영원한 사랑!

[Outro]
영원히... 너만을...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Holding your cold, lifeless hand
I swallow back the words I never got to say
Even if the whole world tears us apart
My soul remembers only you

[Verse 2]
The countless tears I cried for you
At the end of all my wandering, it was always you
Inside the harsh storm of this cruel life
You were my one and only sanctuary

[Pre-Chorus]
Even if heaven abandons me
Even if the fires of hell burn high
I will stand and protect your side!

[Chorus]
Blaze on, an eternal love that never dies!
Until the moment my heart stops beating, I will scream your name!
No darkness can ever stand in our way!
I will surrender my entire soul to protect you!
Forever and ever, I love only you!

[Bridge]
Even if this world comes to an end!
Our love will live on and breathe!

[Chorus]
Until the final day my life runs out!
I will live embracing only you in my arms!
Even death itself can never divide us!
A glorious burning fire of eternal love!

[Outro]
Forever... only you...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
차창을 활짝 내리고 볼륨을 높여
시원한 바람이 머리칼을 흩날려
꽉 막힌 도심을 벗어나는 순간
파란 바다가 저 멀리서 손짓해

[Verse 2]
내비게이션 안내는 잠시 꺼두고
마음이 이끄는 대로 핸들을 꺾어
길가에 늘어선 초록빛 나무들
우리의 탈출을 반겨주는 것 같아

[Pre-Chorus]
답답했던 어제는 백미러 속에 두고
탁 트인 지평선을 향해 엑셀을 밟아
자, 어디로든 떠나보는 거야!

[Chorus]
바람 따라 달리는 이 눈부신 길 위로!
라디오에서 우리가 좋아하는 노래!
목청껏 따라 부르며 웃음 짓는 오늘!
세상 모든 자유가 내 품 안에 쏟아져!

[Bridge]
멈추지 말고 달려가 태양을 향해!
속도를 더 올려봐 저 수평선 너머로!
우리가 꿈꾸던 그 바다가 기다려!

[Chorus]
파도가 부서지는 바닷가에 닿아
두 팔을 벌려 환호성을 질러봐!
오늘 이 순간을 영원히 기억할게!
눈부신 바람과 너와 나만의 여행!

[Outro]
달려가자... 달려가자 저 바다를 향해...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Roll down the car windows wide and turn the volume up
The cool refreshing breeze flutters through our hair
The moment we break free from the congested downtown
The blue ocean waves hello from far away

[Verse 2]
Turn off the GPS navigation for a while
Steer the wheel wherever our hearts lead
The green trees lining up along the roadside
Seem to welcome our sweet great escape

[Pre-Chorus]
Leave yesterday's suffocating worries in the rearview mirror
Step on the gas toward the wide-open horizon
Come on, let's take off anywhere we want!

[Chorus]
Along this dazzling road running with the wind!
Our favorite song playing on the radio!
Singing along at the top of our lungs with bright smiles today!
All the freedom in the world pours right into my arms!

[Bridge]
Don't stop, keep driving toward the blazing sun!
Push the speed higher beyond that horizon!
That dream ocean we always envisioned is waiting for us!

[Chorus]
Reaching the shore where white waves crash and break
Spread your two arms wide and let out a triumphant cheer!
I'll remember this very moment forever!
The dazzling wind, and this journey just for you and me!

[Outro]
Let's drive on... let's drive toward that ocean...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
너를 처음 마주쳤던 그 오후
길가에 살랑이던 연분홍 꽃잎들
눈이 마주친 찰나의 순간
세상이 멈춘 듯 숨이 멎었어

[Verse 2]
어색하게 건네던 작은 인사말
수줍게 붉어지던 너의 두 뺨
어둡고 춥기만 했던 내 마음에
기적처럼 따스한 봄이 찾아왔지

[Pre-Chorus]
가슴속에 나비들이 날아올라
간질거리는 설렘을 어쩌면 좋을까
나도 모르게 미소가 번져와

[Chorus]
봄빛처럼 반짝여, 너와 함께하는 모든 날!
흐린 하늘도 핑크빛으로 물들이는 너!
가만히 내 손을 잡아주는 다정한 온기
꿈결처럼 아름다운 너의 눈동자 속에
영원히 머물고 싶어, 사랑해 내 사람

[Bridge]
계절이 바뀌어 낙엽이 지고 눈이 내려도
너를 향한 내 맘은 언제나 눈부신 봄날

[Chorus]
환하게 피어난 꽃처럼 널 사랑할게!
이 세상 가장 아름다운 빛으로 감싸줄게!
내 모든 순간의 이유가 되어준 너에게
온 마음 다해 고백해, 널 사랑해!

[Outro]
봄빛처럼... 영원히...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
That sunny afternoon when I first met you
Soft pale-pink petals fluttering along the street
The split-second moment our eyes met
The whole world stopped and took my breath away

[Verse 2]
The awkward little hello I softly murmured
Your two cheeks turning shyly rosy red
Into my heart that was once so dark and cold
A miraculous warm spring came blossoming in

[Pre-Chorus]
Butterflies take flight inside my chest
What should I do with this sweet tickling flutter?
Without realizing, a smile spreads across my face

[Chorus]
Shimmering like spring light, every day spent with you!
You color even overcast skies in soft pastel pink!
The gentle warmth as you quietly hold my hand
Inside your eyes as beautiful as a sweet dream
I want to stay forever, I love you, my darling

[Bridge]
Even when seasons shift, autumn leaves fall, and snow comes down
My heart toward you will always be a radiant spring day

[Chorus]
I'll love you like a flower blooming bright!
I'll wrap you in the most beautiful light in this world!
To you who became the reason for every moment of my life
With all my heart I confess, I love you!

[Outro]
Just like spring light... forever and always...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
칠흑 같은 어둠 속에 길을 잃고
차디찬 바닥에 무릎 꿇었을 때
저 멀리서 들려오던 작은 북소리
다시 일어서라 내 심장을 깨우네

[Verse 2]
거친 비바람이 내 앞을 막아서도
상처 입은 깃발을 높이 치켜들고
우리가 걸어갈 저 거대한 대지 위에
새로운 역사의 첫발을 내딛는다

[Pre-Chorus]
두려움은 불꽃 속에 던져버려
우리의 발걸음은 멈추지 않아
자, 고개를 들어라!

[Chorus]
끝나지 않을 행진을 시작하라!
어떤 어둠도 우릴 삼키지 못해!
우리가 함께 부르는 승리의 노래가
온 세상을 뒤흔들며 울려 퍼지리라!
워어- 어어어- 끝까지 전진하라!

[Bridge]
쓰러지면 서로를 일으켜 세우고
함께 손을 잡고 저 언덕을 넘어가리
우리는 반드시 승리하리라!

[Chorus]
타올라라, 세상을 밝히는 불꽃이여!
우리의 행진은 영원히 멈추지 않는다!
가슴 벅찬 환희로 깃발을 꽂으리라!
승리의 찬가를 높이 불러라!

[Outro]
전진하라... 끝까지!
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Lost inside the pitch-black darkness
When I fell to my knees on the freezing ground
A quiet drumbeat echoed from far away
Awakening my heart to rise once again

[Verse 2]
Even when fierce storms block the road ahead
Holding our battle-scarred banner high in the sky
Upon this vast land where we shall march together
We take the very first step of a brand new history

[Pre-Chorus]
Cast every fear into the blazing flames
Our marching footsteps will never stop
Now, lift your heads up high!

[Chorus]
Begin the march that will never end!
No darkness can ever swallow us whole!
The song of victory that we sing together
Will shake the entire world and echo far and wide!
Whoa-oh-oh, march on until the very end!

[Bridge]
When we fall, we lift each other up again
Hand in hand, we will cross over that distant hill
Together, we shall surely prevail!

[Chorus]
Blaze up bright, oh flame that lights the world!
Our solemn march will never stop for eternity!
With overwhelming joy we shall plant our flag!
Sing the anthem of victory loud and high!

[Outro]
March on... until the end!
[End]

tracks.title_kr: 빗방울에 실어 보낸 못다 한 고백
tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
유리창을 두드리는 빗소리 따라
문득 밀려오는 그리운 네 얼굴
언제나 내 곁을 지켜주던 너였는데
익숙함이란 핑계로 소홀했던 나

[Verse 2]
비에 젖은 거리를 우두커니 보며
그때의 네 눈물을 이제야 이해해
사랑이란 말로도 부족했던 너에게
난 너무 많은 상처만 남겨주었지

[Pre-Chorus]
시간을 되돌릴 수만 있다면
네 작은 손을 꼭 잡고 말할 텐데
내 모든 세상은 너였다고

[Chorus]
빗방울에 실어 보낸 못다 한 내 고백
바람결에 흘러 네게 닿을 수 있을까
너 없는 내 하루는 텅 빈 사막 같아
제발 내게 다시 돌아와 주겠니
영원토록 너만을 사랑할 나에게

[Bridge]
이 비가 그치면 안개가 걷히듯
우리의 아픔도 씻겨 내려가길
단 한 번만 다시 기회를 줘

[Chorus]
너 없인 나 아무것도 할 수 없어!
내 심장은 여전히 널 향해 뛰고 있어!
비 갠 하늘 무지개처럼 다시 찾아와줘!
내 마지막 사랑은 오직 너뿐이야!

[Outro]
돌아와줘... 내 사랑...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Following the sound of raindrops tapping on the windowpane
Your longed-for face suddenly rushes back into my mind
You were always the one standing faithfully by my side
While I took you for granted behind the excuse of familiarity

[Verse 2]
Staring blankly out at the rain-soaked street
Only now do I truly understand the tears you shed back then
To you, for whom even the word love was never enough
I left behind far too many painful scars

[Pre-Chorus]
If only I could turn back the hands of time
I would hold your small hands tight and tell you
That you were my entire world

[Chorus]
My unspoken confession sent upon the falling raindrops
Could it drift upon the wind and finally reach your heart?
Without you, every single day is like an empty desert
Would you please come back to me once again,
To me, who will love only you for all eternity?

[Bridge]
Just as the mist clears when this rain finally stops
I pray that all our pain will be washed away
Please give me just one more chance

[Chorus]
Without you, I cannot do a single thing!
My heart is still beating only for you!
Come back to me like a rainbow in the sky after the rain!
My final love in this life is only you!

[Outro]
Please come back... my love...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
어릴 적 뛰놀던 마을 언덕길
그 자리 그대로 서 있는 느티나무
세월이 흘러 어른이 된 나를
오랜 친구처럼 반갑게 맞아주네

[Verse 2]
치열하게 부딪치며 살아가느라
소중한 것들을 잊고 살았나 봐
욕심을 내려놓고 바람을 맞으니
가슴 가득 시원한 평온이 찾아와

[Pre-Chorus]
가진 것 많지 않아도 괜찮아
나를 반겨주는 이 바람과
사랑하는 사람들이 곁에 있으니

[Chorus]
오래된 나무 그늘 아래 쉬어가자!
소박해서 더 따스한 우리 인생길!
시원한 막걸리 한 잔에 웃고
친구들의 정겨운 이야기 속에
오늘 하루도 행복으로 물들어가네!

[Bridge]
비바람 거세게 몰아치는 날에도
깊게 뿌리내린 저 나무처럼
흔들리지 않고 묵묵히 살아가리라

[Chorus]
인생이란 결국 소소한 행복인걸!
좋은 사람들과 함께 나누는 오늘!
걱정 근심은 바람결에 날려버리고
감사한 마음으로 건배를 들어라!

[Outro]
쉬어가자... 오래된 나무 아래서...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The village hill path where I ran and played as a child
The great zelkova tree standing in that exact same spot
Greeting me now grown up after all these years
Welcoming me warmly like a lifelong old friend

[Verse 2]
Living and hustling so fiercely through this world
I suppose I forgot the precious things in life
Letting go of greed and embracing the cool breeze
A refreshing peace fills my entire chest

[Pre-Chorus]
It's okay even if we don't possess much
With this comforting wind that welcomes me
And the beloved people standing right by my side

[Chorus]
Let's take a rest under the shade of this old tree!
Our life's journey, humble and all the warmer!
Laughing over a cool bowl of refreshing makgeolli
Surrounded by the hearty stories of dearest friends
Today is painted in pure happiness once again!

[Bridge]
Even on days when fierce winds and rains crash down
Just like this deeply rooted ancient tree
I will live silently without wavering

[Chorus]
Life is all about the little simple joys after all!
Sharing this wonderful day with genuine folks!
Blow away all worries and sorrows into the gentle wind
And raise a joyful toast with a grateful heart!

[Outro]
Let's rest a while... beneath the old shade of the tree...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
복잡한 도시의 빌딩 숲을 벗어나
파란 바다가 손짓하는 언덕길로
걱정은 주머니 속에 구겨 넣어두고
가벼운 운동화로 발걸음을 옮겨봐

[Verse 2]
살랑이는 바람이 내 볼을 스칠 때
나도 모르게 터져 나오는 콧노래
햇살은 따스하게 어깨를 감싸고
세상은 온통 초록빛으로 반짝이네

[Pre-Chorus]
하나 둘 셋, 리듬에 맞춰 걸어가
지금 이 순간이 가장 눈부신 선물이야

[Chorus]
바람이 머무는 그곳으로 떠나자!
흘러가는 구름처럼 자유롭게 춤을 춰!
네 입가에 번지는 환한 미소 하나면
세상 모든 행복이 내 품 안에 가득해!
라라라 라라라- 기분 좋은 오늘!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
시원한 아이스 커피 한 잔 손에 들고
나무 그늘 아래서 파도 소릴 들어봐
시간이 잠시 멈춘 듯한 이 평화로움
이것이 바로 우리가 꿈꾸던 날들

[Chorus]
바람이 머무는 그곳으로 떠나자!
흘러가는 구름처럼 자유롭게 춤을 춰!
네 입가에 번지는 환한 미소 하나면
세상 모든 행복이 내 품 안에 가득해!

[Bridge]
언제든 지칠 땐 이곳을 기억해
너를 위해 열려있는 푸른 바다를

[Chorus]
바람을 타고 저 끝까지 날아가!
우리의 찬란한 계절은 멈추지 않아!
활짝 웃어봐, 세상이 널 향해 노래해!

[Outro]
라라라- 바람이 머무는 곳으로...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Leaving behind the crowded maze of city towers
Heading towards the hill road where the blue sea waves
Crumpling all my worries deep into my pockets
I step lightly forward in my comfortable sneakers

[Verse 2]
When the tender breeze gently brushes my cheek
A happy humming tune slips out of my lips without knowing
Warm sunlight wraps softly around my shoulders
The whole wide world sparkles in fresh shades of green

[Pre-Chorus]
One, two, three, walk along to the happy rhythm
This very moment is the most dazzling gift of all

[Chorus]
Let's take off to the place where the wind rests!
Dance freely like the white clouds drifting across the sky!
All it takes is that bright, lovely smile spreading on your lips
And all the happiness in the world fills up my heart!
La la la, la la la - what a wonderfully happy today!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
Holding a cup of cool iced coffee in my hand
Listening to the sound of breaking waves under the shade of trees
This sweet, gentle peace as if time itself has stood still
These are the very days we have always dreamed of

[Chorus]
Let's take off to the place where the wind rests!
Dance freely like the white clouds drifting across the sky!
All it takes is that bright, lovely smile spreading on your lips
And all the happiness in the world fills up my heart!

[Bridge]
Whenever you feel weary, remember this haven
The endless blue ocean always open just for you

[Chorus]
Ride upon the wind and fly to the ends of the earth!
Our brilliant season will never, ever come to an end!
Smile with all your heart, the world is singing just for you!

[Outro]
La la la - to where the wind rests...

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
오늘 밤 난 타오르는 유성처럼 하늘을 날아
세상 그 누구도 날 가로막을 수는 없어
엔진을 켜고 속도를 올려, 저 우주 끝까지!
내 심장은 200퍼센트로 뛰고 있으니까!

[Verse 2]
회색빛 도시의 지루한 규칙들은 다 던져버려
우리에겐 오늘 밤 음악과 열정만 있으면 돼
신호등은 전부 초록불로 바뀌고
모두가 우릴 향해 박수를 쳐주네!

[Pre-Chorus]
더 높이, 더 빨리, 한계를 넘어 질주해!
지금 이 순간 우린 살아 숨 쉬고 있어!

[Chorus]
멈추지 마, 오늘 밤은 우리들의 축제야!
세상을 다 가진 듯 자유롭게 노래해!
하늘을 날아올라 태양을 껴안을 때까지!
영원히 빛날 우리들의 찬란한 오늘!
헤이! 헤이! 헤이! 멈추지 마라!

[Guitar Solo]

[Verse 3]
별빛을 밟으며 춤을 추는 기분이야
우릴 향해 쏟아지는 환호의 물결
두려움 따윈 우주 밖으로 날려버렸어
우리의 에너지는 영원히 폭발할 테니!

[Chorus]
멈추지 마, 오늘 밤은 우리들의 축제야!
세상을 다 가진 듯 자유롭게 노래해!
하늘을 날아올라 태양을 껴안을 때까지!
영원히 빛날 우리들의 찬란한 오늘!

[Bridge]
우린 살아있어! (우린 살아있어!)
우린 날고 있어! (우린 날고 있어!)
세상의 중심에서 외쳐라!

[Chorus]
찬란하게 타올라라, 우리들의 오늘이여!
영원히 끝나지 않을 불멸의 노래!
우리의 이름은 별빛이 되어 영원히 빛나리라!

[Outro]
멈추지 마... 바로 지금!
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Tonight I am flying across the sky like a blazing shooting star
No one in this mortal world can ever stop my flight
Ignite the engines and accelerate, to the edge of the cosmos!
Because my heart is pounding at two hundred percent!

[Verse 2]
Toss all the boring rules of the gray concrete city aside
Tonight all we truly need is pure music and burning passion
All the traffic lights turn bright green as we race through
And the whole world stands up to applaud our journey!

[Pre-Chorus]
Higher, faster, break through every barrier and sprint!
At this very moment, we are truly alive and breathing!

[Chorus]
Don't stop now, tonight belongs entirely to our celebration!
Sing out freely as if we possess the whole universe!
Until we soar past the clouds and embrace the burning sun!
Our dazzling, glorious today that will shine on forever!
Hey! Hey! Hey! Don't you ever stop!

[Guitar Solo]

[Verse 3]
It feels like dancing upon the silver starlight
A roaring wave of cheers washing over our joyful steps
All doubts have been catapulted into deep outer space
For our explosive energy will burn through eternity!

[Chorus]
Don't stop now, tonight belongs entirely to our celebration!
Sing out freely as if we possess the whole universe!
Until we soar past the clouds and embrace the burning sun!
Our dazzling, glorious today that will shine on forever!

[Bridge]
We are alive! (We are alive!)
We are flying! (We are flying!)
Shout it aloud from the center of the world!

[Chorus]
Blaze brilliantly, our magnificent today!
An immortal song that will never, ever reach its end!
Our names shall become starlight, shining through all time!

[Outro]
Don't stop... right now!

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
텅 빈 방 안에 홀로 불을 끄고 누워
아직도 방안 가득 배어있는 너의 향기
지우려 애를 써도 더 짙어지는 기억에
베개에 얼굴을 묻고 눈물을 삼킨다

[Verse 2]
너를 만나 행복했던 수많은 날들이
지금은 날 찌르는 날카로운 유리 파편이 되어
숨을 쉴 때마다 심장을 베어내는데
난 왜 아직도 너를 놓지 못할까

[Pre-Chorus]
다시는 돌아오지 않을 사람아
붙잡고 애원해도 멀어지는 그림자

[Chorus]
지울 수 없는 흉터로 남겨진 너!
가슴을 쥐어뜯으며 네 이름을 울부짖어도!
쏟아지는 비처럼 눈물은 멈추지 않고!
죽을 만큼 아파도 널 사랑했던 기억뿐!
너 없는 세상 속에 홀로 버려진 채
피 흘리는 내 마지막 사랑!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
계절이 바뀌어도 내 시간은 멈춰 서서
널 처음 만났던 그 눈부신 거리에 서 있어
차라리 나를 다 태워 재가 된다면
이 지독한 그리움도 끝이 날 텐데

[Pre-Chorus]
더 이상 버틸 수 없는 내 심장이
마지막 힘을 다해 널 부르고 있어!

[Chorus]
지울 수 없는 흉터로 남겨진 너!
가슴을 쥐어뜯으며 네 이름을 울부짖어도!
쏟아지는 비처럼 눈물은 멈추지 않고!
죽을 만큼 아파도 널 사랑했던 기억뿐!

[Bridge]
차라리 내 모든 기억을 앗아가 줘!
너를 사랑했던 내 심장마저 멈추게 해줘!

[Chorus]
영원히 너만을 사랑했던 나였음을!
세상이 끝나도 널 잊지 못할 내 사랑아!
가슴이 찢겨도 널 향해 뛰고 있어!
사랑한다... 내 전부였던 너...

[Outro]
지울 수 없어... 영원히...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Lying in the empty dark room after turning off the lights
Your faint scent still lingers heavy in the cold air
The harder I struggle to erase it, the deeper your memory stains
I bury my face in the pillow and swallow down bitter tears

[Verse 2]
All those countless golden days when I was happy with you
Have now turned into razor-sharp glass shards stabbing my chest
Slicing through my bleeding heart with every single breath I take
Why am I still so helpless, unable to let you go?

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh my love, who will never return to my side again
A fading shadow drifting away no matter how desperately I beg

[Chorus]
Remaining inside me as a scar that can never be erased!
Even when I tear at my chest and scream your name in agony!
Tears pour down endlessly like torrential driving rain!
Even in this dying pain, all that remains is loving you!
Abandoned and forsaken all alone in a world without you
My bleeding, agonizing final love!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
Though the seasons turn, my clock remains frozen in time
Still standing on that dazzling street corner where I first saw you
If only my whole body would burn to dust and vanish away
Perhaps this merciless yearning would finally reach its end

[Pre-Chorus]
My bruised heart that can endure this torment no longer
Is calling out your name with the very last ounce of its strength!

[Chorus]
Remaining inside me as a scar that can never be erased!
Even when I tear at my chest and scream your name in agony!
Tears pour down endlessly like torrential driving rain!
Even in this dying pain, all that remains is loving you!

[Bridge]
I beg you, take all my memories away into nothingness!
Let the very heart that loved you so stop beating forever!

[Chorus]
Know that I was the one who loved only you for eternity!
My love, whom I can never forget even when the world crumbles!
Even torn to shreds, my heart still beats only for you!
I love you... you who were my everything...

[Outro]
I can never erase you... forever...

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
차가운 바람이 옷깃을 여미게 하는 밤
하루 종일 지치고 메마른 발걸음으로
혼자 걷는 이 골목길이 낯설게 느껴질 때
가만히 눈을 감고 네 목소릴 떠올려

[Verse 2]
세상은 늘 나에게 완벽하라 말하지만
너만은 내 지친 어깨를 말없이 안아주었지
비틀거리고 넘어져 상처투성이가 되어도
언제나 날 기다려준 따스한 너의 품

[Pre-Chorus]
어둠이 깊을수록 별은 더 밝게 빛나듯
이제는 알아, 내가 돌아갈 곳이 어디인지

[Chorus]
돌아가는 길 위에 피어나는 따스한 온기!
험한 폭풍이 불어도 난 두렵지 않아!
네가 있는 그곳이 나의 유일한 안식처이자
내가 살아갈 이유니까!
오오오- 너를 향해 달려가는 길!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
가로등 불빛이 하나둘 켜지는 저녁
저 멀리 창문 틈으로 비치는 주황빛 등불
그곳에 네가 서서 날 보며 웃고 있네
세상에서 가장 아름다운 나의 집

[Chorus]
돌아가는 길 위에 피어나는 따스한 온기!
험한 폭풍이 불어도 난 두렵지 않아!
네가 있는 그곳이 나의 유일한 안식처이자
내가 살아갈 이유니까!

[Bridge]
어떤 시련이 우릴 갈라놓으려 해도
난 언제나 너의 곁으로 돌아갈 거야
영원토록 너의 손을 놓지 않을게

[Chorus]
나의 집이 되어준 사랑하는 사람아!
너의 품 안에서 영원한 평화를 노래하리라!
끝없이 이어질 우리들의 따뜻한 날들!

[Outro]
돌아가는 길... 네 곁으로...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
A night when the freezing wind makes me pull my collar tight
With footsteps exhausted and drained from the long day's toil
When this lonely alleyway feels unfamiliar and cold
I gently close my eyes and summon the sound of your voice

[Verse 2]
The world always demands that I be flawless and strong
Yet you alone silently held my weary, slumping shoulders
Even when I stumbled, fell, and was covered in bruised wounds
Your warm embrace was always waiting patiently for me

[Pre-Chorus]
Just as stars shine brightest when the darkness is deepest
Now I finally know where my true home is

[Chorus]
The tender warmth blooming along the road back home!
Though fierce tempests blow, I am no longer afraid!
For where you are is my only true sanctuary and harbor
The very reason why I breathe and live!
Oh oh oh - on the road running straight to you!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
In the evening as streetlights flicker awake one by one
A warm orange lamp glowing through the distant windowpane
There you stand, looking out and smiling just for me
My home, the most beautiful place in all the world

[Chorus]
The tender warmth blooming along the road back home!
Though fierce tempests blow, I am no longer afraid!
For where you are is my only true sanctuary and harbor
The very reason why I breathe and live!

[Bridge]
No matter what cruel trials try to tear us apart
I will always, without fail, return to your loving arms
I will never let go of your gentle hand, forever

[Chorus]
My precious love, who became my true home!
Within your embrace, I will sing of eternal peace!
Our warm, blessed days that will continue without end!

[Outro]
The road back home... right into your arms...

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
바람결에 실려 온 낡은 기억의 조각
잊혀진 줄 알았던 네 이름이 스쳐 지나가
해질녘 붉게 물든 노을을 바라보다
참아왔던 눈물이 뺨을 타고 흘러내린다

[Verse 2]
그땐 왜 몰랐을까, 네가 건넨 그 모든 손길이
세상에서 가장 큰 사랑이었음을
서툰 욕심에 너를 아프게 했던 날들이
가슴속 깊은 곳에 시린 가시로 박혀

[Pre-Chorus]
시간이 흐르면 무뎌질 거란 거짓말
계절이 바뀔수록 그리움은 더 깊어지는데

[Chorus]
밀려오는 기억의 파도 속에 널 부른다!
아무리 손을 뻗어도 닿지 않는 사람아!
바람이 불어올 때마다 네 목소리가 들려
내 심장은 여전히 너만을 기억하고 있어!
돌아갈 수 없는 찬란했던 우리 날들!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
너와 걷던 그 바닷가 모래사장 위에
우리가 새겨두었던 약속들은 지워졌지만
내 가슴속에 새겨진 너의 맑은 눈동자는
영원히 바래지 않고 빛나고 있네

[Chorus]
밀려오는 기억의 파도 속에 널 부른다!
아무리 손을 뻗어도 닿지 않는 사람아!
바람이 불어올 때마다 네 목소리가 들려
내 심장은 여전히 너만을 기억하고 있어!

[Bridge]
만약 우리가 다시 만날 수 있다면
그땐 절대로 너의 손을 놓지 않을 텐데

[Chorus]
사랑했다, 내 목숨보다 더 사랑했던 너!
부디 좋은 사람 만나 아프지 말고 행복하기를
가슴 시린 축복을 바람에 실어 보낸다
안녕... 영원한 나의 사람아...

[Outro]
기억의 파도 속에... 안녕...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
A faded shard of old memory carried upon the passing wind
Your name, which I thought was forgotten, brushes softly past
Gazing out at the crimson glow painted across the sunset sky
Tears held back for so long quietly trickle down my cheek

[Verse 2]
Why didn't I realize back then that every touch of your hand
Was the greatest love in all the wide world?
All those days when my clumsy selfishness caused you pain
Remain lodged deep in my soul like icy, piercing thorns

[Pre-Chorus]
That hollow lie claiming time heals all wounds
For with every changing season, the longing only grows deeper

[Chorus]
Inside the surging waves of memory, I cry out your name!
My love, who remains out of reach no matter how far I stretch!
Whenever the wind blows, I can still hear your gentle voice
My aching heart remembers only you, even to this day!
Our radiant, golden days that can never be returned!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
Upon the sandy seashore where I once walked with you
Though the sweet promises we etched have been washed away
The crystal-clear reflection of your eyes etched in my heart
Continues to shine without fading, for all eternity

[Chorus]
Inside the surging waves of memory, I cry out your name!
My love, who remains out of reach no matter how far I stretch!
Whenever the wind blows, I can still hear your gentle voice
My aching heart remembers only you, even to this day!

[Bridge]
If by some miracle we could meet once again
I would never, ever let go of your hand

[Chorus]
I loved you, you whom I loved far more than my own life!
Please meet someone kind, never hurt, and be truly happy
I send this heart-aching blessing carried upon the wind
Farewell... my eternal, beloved one...

[Outro]
Inside the waves of memory... goodbye...

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
창문 밖엔 후두둑 빗방울이 떨어지고
오늘 약속은 물 건너갔다 생각했지
하지만 옷장에서 꺼낸 샛노란 우산 하나
왠지 모르게 기분이 슬슬 좋아지네

[Verse 2]
장화를 신고 첨벙첨벙 웅덩이를 건너
회색빛 비옷을 입은 사람들 사이로
노란 우산을 빙글빙글 돌리며 걸어가
비 내리는 거리가 작은 무대가 되네

[Pre-Chorus]
물방울 튀는 소리는 신나는 드럼 비트
빗소리에 맞춰 콧노래를 흥얼거려

[Chorus]
노란 우산을 쓰고 빗속을 걸어가자!
뚝뚝 떨어지는 빗방울도 신나는 멜로디야!
우울했던 기분은 빗물에 다 씻어내고
폴짝 뛰어올라 무지개를 찾아가자!
뚜뚜뚜 라라라- 노란 우산의 마법!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
저 건너편 버스 정류장에 비를 피하는 너
어깨를 웅크린 채 곤란한 표정 짓고 있네
슬그머니 다가가 노란 우산을 씌워주며
"함께 쓰실래요?" 용기 내어 건넨 한마디

[Chorus]
노란 우산 아래서 시작된 우리 이야기!
비 내리는 거리가 온통 핑크빛으로 물들어!
너와 내가 마주 보며 터진 수줍은 미소
세상에서 가장 특별한 비 오는 날!

[Bridge]
비가 그치지 않았으면 좋겠어
너와 어깨를 맞대고 걷는 이 길이 너무 좋으니까

[Chorus]
노란 우산을 쓰고 사랑을 노래하자!
빗방울마다 피어나는 우리들의 설렘!
세상 모든 비가 내려도 난 젖지 않아
내 곁에 가장 눈부신 네가 있으니까!

[Outro]
노란 우산 쓰고... 너와 함께...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Pitter-patter go the raindrops against my windowpane
I thought all my plans for today had completely drowned
Yet pulling out a bright yellow umbrella from my closet
For some odd reason, a happy mood begins to sneak in

[Verse 2]
Putting on my rain boots and splashing across the puddles
Through the hurried crowd dressed in dreary gray coats
Spinning my bright yellow umbrella round and round
The rainy street transforms into my very own little stage

[Pre-Chorus]
The splashing raindrops sound like an exciting drum beat
Humming a catchy tune in time with the gentle rhythm of rain

[Chorus]
Let's stroll through the rain under our yellow umbrella!
Even the dripping drops form an upbeat, joyful melody!
Wash all the gloomy feelings away down the rain gutters
Leap high into the air and go searching for the rainbow!
Doo doo doo, la la la - the magic of the yellow umbrella!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
There you stand at the bus stop across the street, dodging the rain
Hunching your shoulders with a helpless, flustered expression
Slipping gently beside you and sheltering you under yellow shade
"Would you like to share?" the brave little words I gathered to speak

[Chorus]
Our sweet story begun beneath the bright yellow umbrella!
The rainy gray street suddenly turns into shades of warm pink!
That shy, tender smile bursting as our eyes meet
The most wonderfully special rainy day in all the world!

[Bridge]
I secretly wish this gentle rain would never, ever stop
Because walking shoulder to shoulder with you is so wonderful

[Chorus]
Let's sing of budding love under our yellow umbrella!
Our fluttering excitement blooming with every single drop!
Even if all the rain in the world pours down, I won't get wet
Because the most dazzling you is standing right beside me!

[Outro]
Under the yellow umbrella... together with you...

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
수많은 사람 중에 널 만난 건
내 삶에 찾아온 가장 큰 기적이야
어색하게 인사를 건네던 첫 만남부터
내 심장은 이미 너를 알아봤나 봐

[Verse 2]
언제나 내 곁을 든든하게 지켜주던
너의 따뜻한 눈빛과 그 미소
힘들었던 모든 날들이 너를 만나
눈부신 봄날로 다시 피어났어

[Pre-Chorus]
[Together] 서로의 손을 꼭 잡은 이 순간
[Together] 우린 알 수 있어, 영원이라는 것을

[Chorus]
[Together] 영원토록 너만을 사랑하겠다고 약속해
[Male] 비바람이 불어와 세상이 흔들려도
[Female] 너의 쉼터가 되어 항상 곁에 머물게
[Together] 수많은 계절이 흐르고 세월이 변해도
[Together] 변치 않는 이 사랑으로 너를 지켜줄게
[Together] 영원한 나의 사랑아

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
[Male] 아침에 눈을 뜨면 가장 먼저 널 바라보고
[Female] 하루의 끝에서도 네 품에 안겨 잠들고 싶어
[Together] 평범했던 모든 일상이 너와 함께라서
[Together] 눈부신 축복이 되었음을 알아

[Chorus]
[Together] 영원토록 너만을 사랑하겠다고 약속해
[Female] 어두운 밤이 찾아와 길을 잃을 때도
[Male] 내가 너의 작은 등불이 되어 비춰줄게
[Together] 수많은 계절이 흐르고 세월이 변해도
[Together] 변치 않는 이 사랑으로 너를 지켜줄게
[Together] 영원한 나의 사랑아

[Bridge]
[Together] 고마워, 내게 와주어서
[Together] 사랑해, 세상 그 누구보다 더
[Together] 이제 우리 둘이서 걸어갈 찬란한 날들

[Chorus]
[Together] 영원히 너의 곁에서 숨 쉬며 사랑하리라!
[Together] 세상의 끝이 와도 결코 놓지 않을 두 손!
[Together] 하늘이 내게 준 가장 눈부신 선물
[Together] 너를 영원히 사랑해, 나의 소중한 사람아

[Outro]
[Together] 영원히... 너만을 사랑해...
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Meeting you among so many people in this world
Is the greatest miracle that ever entered my life
From our very first awkward exchange of hellos
My heart had already recognized who you were

[Verse 2]
Always standing strong by my side
Your warm eyes and gentle smile
All the hard, painful days met you
And bloomed anew into a dazzling spring

[Pre-Chorus]
[Together] Holding each other's hands tight at this moment
[Together] We both know deep down what eternity means

[Chorus]
[Together] I promise to love only you forever and ever
[Male] Even when storms rage and shake the world
[Female] I'll become your haven and stay right by your side
[Together] Though countless seasons pass and years change
[Together] I will protect you with this unchanging love
[Together] My eternal, everlasting love

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
[Male] When I open my eyes in the morning, I want to look at you first
[Female] At the end of the day, I want to fall asleep in your arms
[Together] Because all ordinary daily moments are spent with you
[Together] I know they have become the most dazzling blessings

[Chorus]
[Together] I promise to love only you forever and ever
[Female] Even when dark night falls and you lose your way
[Male] I'll become your little lantern and shine the path for you
[Together] Though countless seasons pass and years change
[Together] I will protect you with this unchanging love
[Together] My eternal, everlasting love

[Bridge]
[Together] Thank you for coming to me
[Together] I love you more than anyone else in this world
[Together] The brilliant days ahead that we two will walk hand in hand

[Chorus]
[Together] I will breathe and love forever by your side!
[Together] Two hands that will never let go even if the world ends!
[Together] The most dazzling gift that heaven ever gave me
[Together] I will love you forever, my precious love

[Outro]
[Together] Forever... loving only you...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
차가운 어둠이 내 발목을 붙잡아도
숨이 턱 끝까지 차오르는 절벽 끝에서
난 결코 무릎 꿇고 쓰러지지 않아
내 안에서 끓어오르는 뜨거운 외침

[Pre-Chorus]
쿵- 쿵- 가슴을 울리는 북소리

쿵쾅거리는 심장의 박동을 느껴봐!
어떤 시련도 날 멈출 수는 없어!
타오르는 불꽃처럼 저 하늘 높이 번져라!

[Verse 2]
넘어질 때마다 난 더 단단해졌고
흘린 눈물마다 새로운 날개가 되었네
비바람을 뚫고 솟구쳐 오르는 독수리처럼
빛을 향해 두 날개를 펼치리라

[Chorus]
쿵쾅거리는 심장의 박동을 느껴봐!
어떤 시련도 날 멈출 수는 없어!
타오르는 불꽃처럼 저 하늘 높이 번져라!
세상을 뒤흔들 우리들의 함성!

[Bridge]
두려움 따윈 집어치워!
우리의 시대는 바로 지금이야!
외쳐라! 소리쳐라!

[Chorus]
타올라라, 나의 붉은 심장이여!
어둠을 찢고 타오르는 승리의 노래!
세상의 꼭대기에서 마침내 포효하리라!

헤이! 헤이! 심장의 박동...

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
새벽 공기를 마시며 창문을 열면
산뜻한 바람이 먼저 인사를 건네
쉼 없이 달려온 어제의 무거운 짐들
잠시 내려놓아도 세상은 괜찮아

[Verse 2]
휘어질 줄 아는 대나무 숲길처럼
조금 느려도 내 걸음대로 걸어가
따스한 햇살이 어깨를 톡톡 두드려
숨을 깊이 들이쉬고 살며시 웃어봐

[Pre-Chorus]
먹구름 뒤에는 언제나 해가 뜨는 법
지친 마음을 쉬어가는 것도 지혜니까

[Chorus]
빛이 나는 시간이야, 지금 이 순간!

바람을 타고 번지는 기분 좋은 멜로디

라라라 라라라- 빛이 나는 오늘!

[Verse 3]
커피 한 잔 손에 들고 벤치에 앉아

사소해서 지나쳤던 수많은 기적들
온 세상이 나를 향해 미소 짓고 있네

[Chorus]
빛이 나는 시간이야, 지금 이 순간!
파란 하늘 아래 자유롭게 콧노래를 불러!
바람을 타고 번지는 기분 좋은 멜로디
내 안에 차오르는 따스한 행복

[Bridge]
조급해하지 마, 멈추어도 좋아
우리의 계절은 가장 예쁘게 피어날 테니

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Opening the window as I breathe in the fresh dawn air
A pleasant breeze comes first to greet my morning
All the heavy burdens from yesterday's endless rush
It is completely fine to set them down for a while

[Verse 2]
Like a bamboo path that knows how to gently sway
Even if I am a bit slow, I walk at my very own pace
Warm gentle sunlight taps softly upon my shoulders
I take a deep breath and let a quiet smile spread

[Pre-Chorus]
Behind every dark storm cloud, the sun always rises
Taking a gentle rest for a weary heart is true wisdom

[Chorus]
This is my shining moment, right here and now!
Humming freely underneath the boundless blue sky!
A feel-good melody spreading across the breeze
A warm, gentle happiness welling up deep inside me
La la la, la la la - what a dazzling today!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
Sitting down on a park bench with a cup of warm coffee
Gently watching the scenery drift quietly by
So many little miracles I once walked past in haste
The whole wide world is smiling warmly just for me

[Chorus]
This is my shining moment, right here and now!
Humming freely underneath the boundless blue sky!
A feel-good melody spreading across the breeze
A warm, gentle happiness welling up deep inside me

[Bridge]
Never rush ahead, it is truly fine to pause
For our blooming season will blossom in the loveliest colors
Sing it out loud, this world is warmer than we ever knew!

[Chorus]
This is my shining moment, across all my days!
Embracing the dazzling sunlight with a radiant smile!
A vibrant rainbow blooming right where the storm once raged
The faithful, grateful wind that always stays right by my side!

[Outro]
It is alright to rest... this shining moment...
[End]

tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
주머니 속을 뒤적이다 찾아낸
작고 알록달록한 막대사탕 하나
입안에 넣자마자 퍼지는 달콤함에
찡그렸던 미간이 스르르 풀리네

[Verse 2]
놀이터 미끄럼틀에게 인사를 건네고
방금 지은 밥 냄새에 배시시 웃음 나
작은 것 하나에 마음이 따뜻해지는
이런 게 진짜 행복인 걸까?

[Pre-Chorus]
복잡한 생각들은 바람에 날려보내
가벼운 운동화 신고 사뿐사뿐 걸어가

[Chorus]
달콤한 사탕처럼 사르르 녹아내려!
걱정 근심 모두 다 솜사탕처럼 날아가!
마음속에 예쁜 종소리가 딩동 울려 퍼질 때
온 세상이 분홍빛으로 물들어 가네!
뚜뚜뚜 라라라- 기분 좋은 오늘!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
길가에 피어난 노란 민들레꽃과
눈이 마주치면 가볍게 윙크해
나를 사랑하고 곁의 사람을 아끼는
순수한 마음 하나면 충분해

[Chorus]
달콤한 사탕처럼 사르르 녹아내려!
걱정 근심 모두 다 솜사탕처럼 날아가!
마음속에 예쁜 종소리가 딩동 울려 퍼질 때
온 세상이 분홍빛으로 물들어 가네!

[Bridge]
가장 달콤한 것은 결국 사랑이야
서로의 손을 잡고 따뜻하게 웃어주는 일
이 작은 온기가 세상을 구원하니까!

[Chorus]
달콤한 사탕처럼 매일매일 행복해져라!
지나간 슬픔 뒤엔 언제나 빛이 기다려!
하늘 높이 깡총 뛰어올라 소리쳐봐
우리의 오늘은 최고의 선물이라고!

[Outro]
달콤한 사탕 하나... 너와 함께...

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Searching through my coat pockets and finding by surprise
A tiny, colorful lollipop tucked away inside
The very moment it touches my tongue with pure sweetness
My furrowed brow gently softens into a smile

[Verse 2]
Waving a friendly hello to the playground slide
Smiling at the cozy aroma of freshly steamed rice
My heart warming up at such simple, little wonders
Could this be what true happiness has always been?

[Pre-Chorus]
Let all the complicated worries drift away on the breeze
Stepping out light and cheerful in my favorite sneakers

[Chorus]
Melting softly away just like sweet candy!
All my worries floating off like fluffy cotton candy!
When a lovely little chime rings ding-dong deep in my heart
The whole wide world turns into shades of rosy pink!
Doo doo doo, la la la - what a wonderfully happy today!

[Interlude]

[Verse 3]
With the little yellow dandelion blooming by the roadside
I exchange a playful wink as our glances meet
Loving who I am and cherishing those standing beside me
A pure, sincere heart is all that we ever need

[Chorus]
Melting softly away just like sweet candy!
All my worries floating off like fluffy cotton candy!
When a lovely little chime rings ding-dong deep in my heart
The whole wide world turns into shades of rosy pink!

[Bridge]
The sweetest thing in all the world is love after all
Holding each other's hands and sharing a warm smile
Because this little warmth is what truly saves the world!

[Chorus]
May every single day be sweet like colorful candy!
Beyond all passing sorrow, the light is always waiting!
Hop high into the open sky and shout it out loud
That our today is the most precious gift of all!

[Outro]
Just one sweet candy... together with you...
[End]

바람의 등을 타고 조용히 날아오르면

그저 너와 나란히, 구름 따라 걸어간다

내가 밀어 준 만큼 다시 돌아오는 흔들림
비워 낸 자리마다 노을빛이 고인다
긴 설명이 없어도 다 아는 눈빛으로
우리는 같은 하늘을 올려다본다

구름보다 마음이 먼저 가면 바람이 되고
바람보다 느리게 걸어가면 구름이 된다
가려면 기다려야 하고
기다리면 찾아오는 계절처럼
그저 너와 나란히, 구름 따라 걸어간다

행복한 마음에는 그늘이 없고
노래하는 사람은 사랑을 안다

구름보다 마음이 먼저 가면 바람이 되고

계절이 흘러가도 변하지 않는 순리처럼

기다리면 찾아오는

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Gentle fingerpicked acoustic guitar and warm harmonica)

[Verse 1]
When the water mist clears, the open clear sky unfolds,
And an nameless gentle breeze blows over the rolling hill.
Even without rushing a season that hasn't arrived,
Time walks toward us in its own steady pace.

[Verse 2]
A single white paper heart folded long ago,
When it gently takes flight upon the wind's back,
Your quiet breath sitting softly beside me,
Unnoticed, becomes my guiding path.

[Chorus]
If the heart moves before the clouds, it becomes the wind,
If we walk slower than the wind, we become the clouds.
Just like the seasons that arrive
Whenever we wait with patience,
Side by side with you, I walk following the clouds.

[Verse 3]
The gentle swing returns as much as I pushed forward,
Sunset golden glow pools in every hollowed space.
Without any long words, through knowing eyes alone,
Together we look up at the very same sky.

[Chorus]
If the heart moves before the clouds, it becomes the wind,
If we walk slower than the wind, we become the clouds.
Just like the seasons that arrive
Whenever we wait with patience,
Side by side with you, I walk following the clouds.

[Bridge]
In a joyful heart, there is never any shadow,
And those who sing understand what love truly is.
Upon this hill where the breeze lingers softly,
Today, I wish to sing with you.

[Final Chorus]
If the heart moves before the clouds, it becomes the wind,
If we walk slower than the wind, we become the clouds.
Like the unchanging rhythm as seasons turn and flow,
Upon the tip of blowing breeze, I send my heart to you.

[Outro]
Arriving whenever we wait,
Following the clouds, I walk on.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Mellow clean electric guitar chords and rain-like piano notes)

[Verse 1]
Though people welcome sunny days and dislike the gray,
When the rain pours down, we open up our umbrellas anyway.
A single little umbrella cannot shelter everything,
So with one shoulder always soaked, I keep walking on.

[Verse 2]
Ever since we learned we can smile even when we hurt,
We put on a polite grin just to conceal our inner hearts.
Since clumsy comfort only returns with deeper scars,
Let us just sit together in silence today without a word.

[Chorus]
If the burning sun scorches all the clouds away,
Even on days we want to weep, not a single raindrop falls.
A sky that is too endlessly clear can sometimes be so cruel,
So let us begin: practicing rain inside our hearts.
What color is the rain that you are seeing today?

[Verse 3]
When clouds get heavy filled to the brim with misty air,
Falling down to earth is nature's simplest law.
Why do you carry that heavy cloud all alone on your head,
Pretending everything is fine under painted sunny days?

[Chorus]
If the burning sun scorches all the clouds away,
Even on days we want to weep, not a single raindrop falls.
A sky that is too endlessly clear can sometimes be so cruel,
So let us begin: practicing rain inside our hearts.
What color is the rain that you are seeing today?

[Bridge]
Do not swallow every joy and sorrow deep inside.
By the time your wet shoulders gently dry away,
A tender breeze will surely blow across your heart.

[Final Chorus]
Just like a quiet forest that finally breathes anew
After the clouds turn to rain and moisten the thirsty earth,
Underneath the lightened sky washed clean by a downpour,
Let us fold our umbrellas and walk side by side.
The rain that you are seeing today feels so warm and kind.

[Outro]
Let us practice letting rain fall down,
Because getting soaked is completely fine.

tracks.lyrics_kr:

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar solo)

[Verse 1]
They say dress shoes were never meant for long walking,
Yet on that day, I wore them and crossed over the hill.
Those uncomfortable footsteps felt strangely light and free,
So I walked a long while down the path where gentle breezes blow.

[Verse 2]
Watching the clock, a single minute feels so slow,
Yet lost in sweet reflection, a whole day flies by.
Just as paper folded too many times cannot fly far away,
Our hearts fly light and high only when folded once.

[Chorus]
Holding my shoes in one hand, barefoot and free,
Countless times I walked past the front of your old home.
Time and happiness don't always run in equal measure,
So not all long years turn into cherished memories.
Yet that cool breeze that brushed past coming down the hill
Still lingers vividly and refreshingly against my cheek.

[Verse 3]
Like a worn-out leather belt kept for seventeen long years,
Things familiar to the touch are never easy to let go.
At the corner of your quiet alley left vacant without a word,
Only the warm afternoon sunlight gathers quietly.

[Chorus]
Holding my shoes in one hand, barefoot and free,
Countless times I walked past the front of your old home.
Time and happiness don't always run in equal measure,
So not all long years turn into cherished memories.
Yet that cool breeze that brushed past coming down the hill
Still lingers vividly and refreshingly against my cheek.

[Bridge]
Being together for a long time doesn't make everything beautiful.
If we can simply bring it out sometimes and share a quiet smile,
With that alone, we have lived our days quite wonderfully.

[Final Chorus]
Holding my shoes in one hand, barefoot and free,
Slowly I walk down the familiar hillside trail.
Even without clinging to the seasons that have passed,
Just like the refreshing breeze that greets me unexpectedly,
Today I stand a little lighter than yesterday.

[Outro]
In front of your old home,
Only the breeze passes by.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Warm Rhodes piano chords and mellow clean guitar)

[Verse 1]
When I breathe warm air onto the frosty windowpane,
For a brief moment, white warmth gently spreads across.
On days when words of right and wrong cut sharply like a blade,
What thawed my frozen heart was your brief, caring greeting.

[Verse 2]
Like porcelain that endured the blazing kiln's heat,
Words held deeply in the heart do not easily grow cold.

[Chorus]
What moves the depths of human heart
Is never fancy prose, but the temperature of words.
At the tired end of my cooling day,
Your voice seeped in like a warm sip of pure water.
Your tender warmth allows me to breathe once more.

[Verse 3]
Sound without resonance turns into hollow noise,
Yet a single sincere word turns into a song.
A quiet, gentle smile exchanged while meeting eyes.

[Chorus]
What moves the depths of human heart
Is never fancy prose, but the temperature of words.
At the tired end of my cooling day,
Your voice seeped in like a warm sip of pure water.
Your tender warmth allows me to breathe once more.

[Bridge]
The way to cross through freezing winter seasons
Is sharing warmth into each other's empty cup.

[Final Chorus]
What remains in the place where love once lingered
Is ultimately the temperature of words we shared.
Even on nights when icy wind blows freezing cold,
Because of that one phrase you offered, my winter stays so warm.

[Outro]
Your voice that never grows cold,
Such a warm temperature of words.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody)

[Verse 1]
They say nature never creates sharp square angles,
Yet the city where we dwell is filled with square boxes.
On tired afternoons bruised by sharp jagged edges,
I take out a round little candy resting in my pocket.

[Verse 2]
The moment it rolls upon my tongue, a refreshing scent blooms,
And a small open window unlocks inside my stifled chest.

[Chorus]
Just as a single peppermint candy clears up all the gloom,
Whenever I think of you, my whole day turns so refreshing.
Melting away the sharp corners of this jagged world,
You are the sweetest summer breeze inside my pocket.
Even if anyone begs for it, this is the one thing I'll never give away!

[Verse 3]
Like a marble drawn so round as if made by compass lines,
The heart must also be round to roll far into the world.
A spontaneous smile naturally spreads across my frowning face.

[Chorus]
Just as a single peppermint candy clears up all the gloom,
Whenever I think of you, my whole day turns so refreshing.
Melting away the sharp corners of this jagged world,
You are the sweetest summer breeze inside my pocket.
Even if anyone begs for it, this is the one thing I'll never give away!

[Bridge]
No need to travel far away searching for grand happiness.
A tiny piece of sweet comfort is more than enough for today.

[Final Chorus]
Just as footsteps lighten up with a single peppermint candy,
Whenever I am with you, every place feels like a picnic.
Rolling smoothly and roundly through this square world,
A cool refreshing breeze blows into our afternoon.

[Outro]
Right into this fragrant, happy mood,
Rolling along with you.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar and harmonica)

[Verse 1]
Slipping the hurried watch into my jacket pocket,
With slightly slower footsteps, I climb up the hill.
The wind never asks where it is meant to go,
And the drifting clouds covet no place to stay.

[Verse 2]
With both hands made light having let go of grasping all,
Only the warm glow of afternoon sunset gently gathers.

[Chorus]
Even without rushing, the season arrives on time,
Even without speaking, heart reaches heart.
At the gentle pace of the afternoon clouds drifting by,
Today, I walk quietly by your side.

[Verse 3]
Even the tiny unnamed flower blossoming beside the road
Sways softly holding its own share of warm sunlight.
Why was I in such a hurry, running with eyes fixed only ahead?

[Chorus]
Even without rushing, the season arrives on time,
Even without speaking, heart reaches heart.
At the gentle pace of the afternoon clouds drifting by,
Today, I walk quietly by your side.

[Bridge]
As much as the quiet hours left unfilled, the gentle wind blows in
And softly smooths out all the wrinkles of yesterday.

[Final Chorus]
Even without rushing, the season arrives on time,
Whenever we wait patiently, spring returns without fail.
At the speed of the afternoon dyed in sunset hues,
Let us simply walk together to the very end of this road.

[Outro]
Just as the breeze blows,
Let us walk slowly on.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Delicate solo grand piano and warm cello)

[Verse 1]
Like an unfinished letter left half-written,
The deepest feelings always linger behind the line break.
On nights when clamorous words have all scattered away,
In every empty space left open, your warmth gently fills the room.

[Verse 2]
Even where petals have fallen, the fragrance still remains,
And upon the sands washed by the waves, ocean ripples sparkle.

[Chorus]
Things that remain even after love has passed,
The quiet gaze that spoke clearly without explanation.
Within the margin made all the more beautiful because it wasn't fully filled,
We still breathe quietly together.

[Verse 3]
Just as bending tree branches endure the strongest gales,
A gentle and tender heart overcomes the harshest season in the end.
In every wounded place, fresh new skin begins to heal.

[Chorus]
Things that remain even after love has passed,
The quiet gaze that spoke clearly without explanation.
Within the margin made all the more beautiful because it wasn't fully filled,
We still breathe quietly together.

[Bridge]
That night you held out your hand instead of clumsy words of comfort,
That quiet silence alone kept me alive and standing.

[Final Chorus]
Things that remain even after the seasons have turned,
The one and only sincere truth carved out by the flow of time.
At the end of the white, unwritten margin of my heart,
Today again, I write a single sentence named 'You'.

[Outro]
In every vacant space left open,
You linger quietly.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Delicate grand piano notes with a warm solo cello)

[Verse 1]
At the quiet edge of dawn as dusk gently settles,
Resonanceless noises fade slowly into the distance.
Even if warm sunlight reaches late beneath tall towering trees,
The tiny wildflower quietly sprouts its leaves toward the light.

[Verse 2]
On days when raging winds blow and shake the body,
I gaze upon the deep forest that bends but never breaks.
Even the quiet pause to stop and catch one's breath
Is merely a season needed to walk forward once again.

[Chorus]
Do not leave your precious heart out in the cold.
Your heart learns and takes shape from how you treat yourself.
Even in shaded corners, flowers blossom without fail,
And seasons grow deeper by the trials we have crossed.
Just as you are, embrace yourself warmly today.

[Verse 3]
Even the bare winter tree with all its leaves fallen
Quietly nurtures springtime deep within its roots.
The path that begins right from the place you thought was the end.

[Chorus]
Do not leave your precious heart out in the cold.
Your heart learns and takes shape from how you treat yourself.
Even in shaded corners, flowers blossom without fail,
And seasons grow deeper by the trials we have crossed.
Just as you are, embrace yourself warmly today.

[Bridge]
Wherever the raging storm has swept across,
Without fail, the morning sun rises anew.
In your eyes that crossed over the long dark night,
The clearest and purest light comes to rest.

[Final Chorus]
Do not leave your precious heart out in the cold.
Your heart learns and takes shape from how you treat yourself.
Like a wildflower that finally bloomed stepping over darkness,
Your season of brilliance will shine from this moment on.

[Outro]
Your own heart
Learns from how you love yourself.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Gentle 3/4 waltz acoustic guitar and warm pedal steel)

[Verse 1]
The shoes mother bought for me during childhood
Were always one size bigger than my feet.
Though they felt a bit loose with every little step,
That extra room was the space for my tomorrow to grow.

[Verse 2]
While crossing through the seasons with clumsy steps,
Before I knew it, that warmth fit my growing feet so snugly.

[Chorus]
Your love was also always one size bigger,
Generously embracing everything I lacked.
Never rushing me until I had fully grown,
The one who waited patiently leaving an open space.
Inside that spacious heart, I become a grown-up.

[Verse 3]
The world measures me with its rigid, exact scale,
Yet only you saw the hidden tomorrow inside of me.
That once-uncomfortable margin became my most comfortable home.

[Chorus]
Your love was also always one size bigger,
Generously embracing everything I lacked.
Never rushing me until I had fully grown,
The one who waited patiently leaving an open space.
Inside that spacious heart, I become a grown-up.

[Bridge]
Now before someone else's fragile season,
I too wish to keep an open, wider embrace for them.

[Final Chorus]
Like those days running in shoes one size bigger,
With fluttering excited steps, I walk toward you.
Within the warmth that deepens as the years go by,
Today again, your embrace is the warmest haven for me.

[Outro]
Waiting for me to grow,
Your heart that is one size bigger.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Poignant solo violin melody over warm piano chords)

[Verse 1]
The earthen jar resting upon the terrace platform
Seems to sit doing nothing at all,
Yet through every invisible, tiny breathing pore,
It quietly takes in the sunlight and the wind.

[Verse 2]
Just as no lush forest is ever created overnight,
Deep, rich flavor always passes through slow, patient time.

[Chorus]
Waiting is not time standing frozen and still,
It is a season ripening in places unseen.
Fragrance gathers where wind and rain have brushed by,
And the heart deepens as much as it endured the dark.
Do not be impatient; you are ripening so beautifully.

[Verse 3]
At the quiet corner of a season thought to be finished,
We meet tomorrow that needs a little more filling.
Because there is an opening, the breeze can flow through.

[Chorus]
Waiting is not time standing frozen and still,
It is a season ripening in places unseen.
Fragrance gathers where wind and rain have brushed by,
And the heart deepens as much as it endured the dark.
Do not be impatient; you are ripening so beautifully.

[Bridge]
Like ancient sacred ruins that endured a thousand years,
Today's humble hours gather to form the great history that is you.

[Final Chorus]
Waiting is not time drifting away in vain,
It is a season transforming into the most precious treasure.
With the deep resonance crafted by golden sunlight and wind,
When the lid is finally opened, fragrance will flood the entire world!

[Outro]
Embracing the wind and the sunlight,
Our time deepens gracefully.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Bright acoustic guitar strumming and clean electric guitar chimes)

[Verse 1]
Under a sudden summer shower that caught us unprepared,
I halt my steps beneath the small eaves of a roof.
Though one shoulder is already thoroughly soaked,
The scent of fresh grass spreads across the chilled air.

[Verse 2]
On days when a single umbrella cannot cover it all,
Let us just stand listening to the rhythm of the rain.

[Chorus]
After the shower stops, the sky opens up clearer,
And raindrops clinging to the tips of leaves sparkle brightly.
Getting soaked for a moment does not mean the road has vanished.
Brush it off, rise up, and we can just walk on again!

[Verse 3]
When blue clouds reflect upon the pooled puddle on the ground,
Heavy footsteps feel so much lighter.
Passing clouds were never meant to be held onto anyway.

[Chorus]
After the shower stops, the sky opens up clearer,
And raindrops clinging to the tips of leaves sparkle brightly.
Getting soaked for a moment does not mean the road has vanished.
Brush it off, rise up, and we can just walk on again!

[Bridge]
Only with cloudy days do we truly welcome the golden sun.
As long as it takes for damp sneakers to dry out in the breeze,
Our hearts will also become stronger and more resilient.

[Final Chorus]
The gentle breeze that blows after the shower has ceased,
A rainbow spreads across the streets washed clean of all dust.
Let yesterday's tears wash away into the rainwater,
With a lightened heart, we can simply start anew!

[Outro]
Upon the streets where the rain has ceased,
Golden sunlight falls warm and bright.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Warm acoustic guitar strumming and gentle harmonica melody)

[Verse 1]
When the water mist rises, the clear open sky comes into view.
Upon the breezy hill where I used to wait for the train that never came,
Like a birthday card tucked away long ago inside a book,
The forgotten season returns riding upon the gentle breeze.
Just like that day waiting to grow into shoes one size bigger,
Our time, too, will slowly find its rightful place.

[Pre-Chorus]
A single white paper plane folded only once and flown,
Riding upon the wind's back, crosses over the distant hill.

[Chorus]
If the heart moves before the clouds, it becomes the wind,
If we walk slower than the wind, we become the clouds.
Things that require waiting if you wish to go, and arrive when you wait patiently.
It is alright to turn off the navigation for a while;
Because you, sitting softly by my side, are my true path.
Following the clouds, let us walk slowly down this road.

[Instrumental Interlude]
(Melodic acoustic guitar and warm harmonica solo)

[Verse 2]
When I push the swing, the swing gently pushes me back in return.
Like the worn-out leather belt kept close for seventeen long years,
Things that stayed beside me for a long time silently watch over me.
Even if a small pebble cast into the lake creates wide ripples,
If you gaze softly, before you know it, it becomes a serene mirror.
Flowing water always finds its way to the very same sea.

[Pre-Chorus]
Sitting quietly by your side instead of offering clumsy comfort,
This precious hour spent looking up together at clouds in the same sky.

[Chorus]
If the heart moves before the clouds, it becomes the wind,
If we walk slower than the wind, we become the clouds.
Things that require waiting if you wish to go, and arrive when you wait patiently.
It is alright to turn off the navigation for a while;
Because you, sitting softly by my side, are my true path.
Following the clouds, let us walk slowly down this road.

[Bridge]
A happy soul has no shadows cast upon the heart,
And those who sing already know what love truly is.
On days when you wish to linger with the gentle wind,
Stay right here and sing together with me.

[Guitar Solo]
(Uplifting, warm acoustic slide guitar solo building gently)

[Final Chorus]
If the heart moves before the clouds, it becomes the wind,
If we walk slower than the wind, we become the clouds.
Like the immutable law of nature that remains unchanged as years flow by,
Longing for that dear person, reach out and touch the blowing wind.
Following the clouds, down this road, let us walk together.

[Outro]
Upon the breezy hill,
Singing softly with you.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Delicate grand piano solo with a warm, lonely cello line)

[Verse 1]
The dawn sky where dusk gently settled is so quiet and still.
The sounds of this world without resonance are always merely noise,
Yet just as the potter at the kiln behind the mountain crafts clay and glaze,
What warm and comforting words shall I pour into your heart?
Even in places veiled by the shade of tall trees where sunlight cannot reach,
Like a flower that persistently sprouts its leaves seeking the direction of the sun.

[Pre-Chorus]
Though bamboo may bend against raging winds,
It never breaks; so it is truly fine to pause and rest.

[Chorus]
Do not let your precious heart grow cold;
Your heart learns and takes shape from how you treat yourself.
Just as a tiny wildflower blooming beneath the shade of towering trees
Blossoms into a beautiful flower in its very own season.
You do not need to struggle to understand everything;
If we simply acknowledge and accept each other just as we are,
Warm and gentle light will bloom even within this cold world.

[Instrumental Interlude]
(Warm piano and soaring string quartet melody)

[Verse 2]
Just as clouds turn into rain when filled to the brim with mist,
Whenever you are hurting, a gentle rain falls inside my heart as well.
In this world where we walk upon a tightrope like a Möbius strip,
Even when you feel like collapsing, exhausted before time that turns and returns,
Like a butterfly that melts away its cocoon and takes flight into the sky,
Our souls grow deeper as much as the trials we have crossed.

[Pre-Chorus]
A single person who listens quietly to my story—
If only that one person is there, heartaches will surely fade away.

[Chorus]
Do not let your precious heart grow cold;
Your heart learns and takes shape from how you treat yourself.
Just as a tiny wildflower blooming beneath the shade of towering trees
Blossoms into a beautiful flower in its very own season.
You do not need to struggle to understand everything;
If we simply acknowledge and accept each other just as we are,
Warm and gentle light will bloom even within this cold world.

[Bridge]
If we could foresee the storm, perhaps the wounds would be less,
Yet remember, whenever the storm passes, the golden sun always rises.
You who have crossed through the long, dark night
Are already a person worthy to shine so brilliantly.

[Final Chorus]
Do not let your precious heart grow cold;
Your heart learns and takes shape from how you treat yourself.
Like a wildflower that finally bloomed at the end of revolving seasons,
Let us live holding fast to faith, justice, and love.
As sunlight fills every space where the raging storm once swept,
Your season of radiance will shine brightly from this moment on!

[Outro]
Do not let your heart grow cold;
Your heart learns from you.
To you whom I love dearly.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Bright upbeat acoustic guitar strumming, lively rolling banjo and cheerful country fiddle hook)

[Verse 1]
Just because I loved seeing the smile upon your face,
Today again, like a fool, I threw out a silly joke.
Even while watching your fingertips tremble as you packed your bags,
I whistled a cheerful tune, pretending nothing was wrong.

[Verse 2]
Inside my pocket, my car key and house key clink against each other,
And that jingling sound feels unusually loud tonight.
It is an evening when everyone finds their place and turns on the lights,
Yet on this empty street, only my heart failed to find a place to park.

[Pre-Chorus]
Since the day I learned that one can smile even in sorrow,
Because that was my very last consideration for you.

[Chorus]
I must have only learned how to smile and forgotten how to cry!
I even wave my hand at your silhouette as you walk away!
Even the breeze that once blew kindly feels cold like a stranger today,
And on this highway racing so brightly, I alone am standing still!
I am smiling like a fool, so why does the road ahead keep blurring?

[Instrumental Interlude]
(Lively country fiddle solo trading licks with crying pedal steel guitar)

[Verse 3]
Our seasons together shrink smaller inside the rearview mirror,
A night where a single minute stretches out like an entire day.
Even as I step on the gas against the cool night wind,
The blocked road inside my chest refuses to clear.

[Pre-Chorus]
All the foolish things I did just to make the one I love smile
Ended up becoming the farewell that makes me cry.

[Chorus]
I must have only learned how to smile and forgotten how to cry!
I even wave my hand at your silhouette as you walk away!
Even the breeze that once blew kindly feels cold like a stranger today,
And on this highway racing so brightly, I alone am standing still!

[Bridge]
Afraid that my face, smiling brightly to the end so you wouldn't cry,
Might remain as the most painful scar inside your memory,
Today again, I willingly remain a foolish man!

[Final Chorus]
Because I only learned how to smile, I cannot hold you back in the end!
Behind the cheerful sound of spinning wheels, I hide my falling tears!
Tapping my empty pocket where only two lonely keys remain,
Like a man with nothing wrong at all, I sing into the night sky!

[Outro]
Because one can smile even when it hurts...
Farewell, my love...

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
(Bouncy country swing acoustic guitar, bright mandolin and lively fiddle melody)

[Verse 1 - Male]
Another season of wavering hesitation passes by,
And I stand alone at the end of the road I flew like a wild goose.
Keeping our hearts in the very same place while living under different skies,
Like a fool, I believed that time alone would work everything out.

[Verse 2 - Female]
Leaning against the bus window, watching the passing scenery flow,
I stared only at the clock hands, thinking even a single minute felt so long.
Because clumsy comfort only leaves scars upon each other,
With a lie that I was doing fine, I gently set the receiver down.

[Pre-Chorus - Male & Female]
Like a Mobius strip with no way out to escape,
A longing that returns right back to where it started whenever we turn around.

[Chorus - Duet]
While feeling the very same wind, why do we walk on different roads?
So close I could almost reach out and touch you, yet out of reach, my love!
Even when I stomp my feet along to the sound of cheerful music,
All that reflects inside the glass is our hollow, empty space!
Our love has not ended yet, only the seasons are walking away!

[Instrumental Interlude]
(Upbeat country fiddle and acoustic guitar duet solo)

[Verse 3 - Male & Female]
They say those in tears do not know the lingering echo left behind,
Yet a wounded heart can never forget the warmth we once shared.
In this life of ours where waiting on time alone changes nothing at all,
Today again upon this windswept hill, I call out only your name.

[Chorus - Duet]
While feeling the very same wind, why do we walk on different roads?
So close I could almost reach out and touch you, yet out of reach, my love!
Even when I stomp my feet along to the sound of cheerful music,
All that reflects inside the glass is our hollow, empty space!

[Bridge - Female & Male]
It wasn't out of hatred that we parted ways,
Nor did we ever try our best to forget,
So why does only our time keep passing each other by?

[Final Chorus - Duet]
Keeping our hearts in the same place as we cross through different nights!
We shake off this unstoppable loop of love with a song!
Someday when this long wind finally stops and we meet in one place,
Then without wavering ever again, I will hold your hand tight!

[Outro - Duet]
Same heart, under different skies...
Our song sent riding upon the wind...

tracks.lyrics_en:
In a clear stream, a little crayfish hides beneath a rock out of shyness.
My wounded heart also hid under a rock, unable to reach out to the world.
Even inside a hard sugarcane stalk, a sweet taste is waiting when you bite in.
When you call me by a sweet nickname, I run to you wagging my tail like a puppy.
Heart to heart without a word, even my heart hiding under the rock blooms with sweetness at the sound of your voice.

Holding my parents' hands tightly as a child, I bought a shiny bicycle at the shop.
Thanks to the strong legs built back then, I have endured the steep hills of this world.
Like a swing that goes forward and gets pushed back, my life takes one step forward and two steps back.
Even if there is no one behind to push me, the wind at my back is enough.
As long as strength remains in my two legs, let's press the pedals and keep going down the road.

Oh, my choking sweet-potato love, someone pour me a cool glass of cider!

No matter how much I empty it out, regrets keep piling up again.
I sorted all the recycling tonight with both hands full of plastic and paper.
They say alcohol hormones erase memories, so why did I only lose one shoe while your face grew clearer?
Like a seesaw that rises on the other side when you press it down, the more I try to forget, the more you pop up.
After saying hello to the empty playground slide and taking a clean shower at home, no one will know I cried there.

So why am I still standing in the same place after swallowing only farewells?
Craving sweet honey, I touched the beehive knowing the danger.

tracks.lyrics_en:
When we begin, grand dreams are on every tongue,
But at the journey's end, not all stand the same.
Even when the world shook its head, saying it's impossible,
We poured in our burning time instead of giving up.
Though shattered hundreds of times, fallen on the cold ground,
We walked the path, our vision made real by our own two feet.
The deeper the darkness, the fiercer the flame within me burns.
Rise again! My heart beats like a drum.

[Pre-Chorus]
Never cease your steps that cross beyond all limits.
Now, lift your head and gaze upon the heights!

[Chorus]
Our time is not over yet!
Even the fiercest storms cannot halt our march!
Pouring our time into the impossible until the very end,
Finally, throw open the world's closed doors!
Woah- oh-oh-oh- Push forward to the end!

While some stood still, speaking words behind our backs,
We awakened the dawn in the name of passion.
The drops of sweat we shed became a path upon the earth,
Rewriting the final page of glorious history.

[Chorus]
Our time is not over yet!
Even the fiercest storms cannot halt our march!
Pouring our time into the impossible until the very end,
Finally, throw open the world's closed doors!

[Bridge]
If you fall, take a hand and rise again!
Our hearts are still beating fiercely!
Burn bright, oh flame that will never be extinguished!
Our time, from this moment, is the true beginning!
Shout the song of overwhelming victory to the heavens' end!

[Outro]
Woah- oh-oh-oh- Push forward to the end!
Our time... is not over yet!

tracks.lyrics_kr:

세상의 꼭대기에서 소리쳐!

tracks.lyrics_en:
To build a verdant garden in the empty air
A dream everyone scorned, deeming it impossible
Just like the day we first took flight to the moon
Fearlessly, we reached our hands into the vast expanse
Though to others, it seemed a trivial thing
A miracle built with sweat, night after unseen night
Climbing each step of countless failures, one by one
At last, we made our own flowers bloom above the clouds
My heart is pounding, about to burst!
In this moment, the world gazes up at us!
Sing out, tonight is our grand celebration!
Our brilliant garden, built high in the heavens!
With my own two hands, I forged a miracle no one believed in!
Our anthem, destined to shine hotter than the sun!
Hey! Hey! Hey! Soar to the edge of the sky!
Beyond the gray forest of buildings, higher than the clouds
The green trees we planted dance in the wind
All these miracles are the story we brought to life
Open your arms wide, embrace this wind with freedom!
Sing out, tonight is our grand celebration!
Our brilliant garden, built high in the heavens!
Our brilliant garden, built high in the heavens!
With my own two hands, I forged a miracle no one believed in!
Our anthem, destined to shine hotter than the sun!
We did it!
Walk upon the clouds!
Shout from the world's highest peak!
Bloom brilliantly, oh garden in the sky!
Our great today, that will never fade!
With starlight as our stage, we'll sing endlessly!
In truth, I... it's the miracle we created!

tracks.lyrics_kr:
끝없이 펼쳐진 거친 야생의 초원 위에

어깨를 나란히 하고 저 지평선을 봐!
달려가라, 초원을 가르는 거대한 바람처럼!
우리는 서로를 지키며 끝까지 전진한다!
그 어떤 위협도 우리의 대열을 꺾지 못해!
함께 부르는 생명의 찬가가 대지를 깨우리라!

달려가라, 초원을 가르는 거대한 바람처럼!

그 어떤 위협도 우리의 대열을 꺾지 못해!
함께 부르는 생명의 찬가가 대지를 깨우리라!
내 손을 잡아라, 너는 혼자가 아니다!
태양이 떠오르는 저 언덕 너머까지!
타올라라, 대지를 흔드는 우리들의 발걸음이여!
서로를 지켜주며 영원히 전진하리라!
찬란한 아침 해가 우리의 머리 위에 빛난다!

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Verse 1]
Across the wild savanna, stretching without end
When bitter winds and dark shadows descend
Though this savage season is too fierce to face alone
We have comrades, guarding each other's backs, our own
Towards the one true goal, the will to survive
As thousands of hooves thunder, making the earth alive
Fear scatters like dust, carried by the wind's embrace
The mighty tremor of the land carves out a new space

[Pre-Chorus]
Alone we may falter, but together, we forge the way!
Shoulder to shoulder, gaze at the horizon's sway!

[Chorus]
Run, like the great wind that sweeps the savanna wide!
We guard each other, advancing with nothing to hide!
No threat can ever break our unwavering line!
The hymn of life we sing together, the earth will entwine!
Woah- oh-oh-oh- never stop, let your spirit fly!

[Verse 2]
If one grows weary, falling behind, we'll match their stride
If a raging river blocks our path, we'll be the bridge, side by side
The heart that helps another, our strongest weapon's might
Until we plant our banner on the promised land, bathed in light

[Chorus]
Run, like the great wind that sweeps the savanna wide!
We guard each other, advancing with nothing to hide!
No threat can ever break our unwavering line!
The hymn of life we sing together, the earth will entwine!

[Bridge]
Take my hand, you are never alone!
Beyond that hill where the rising sun is shown!
Ignite, our footsteps shaking the very ground!
Protecting each other, forever onward bound!

[Outro]
The glorious morning sun shines brightly overhead!
Run together... to the horizon's farthest thread!

tracks.lyrics_kr:
모두가 평화롭게 잠든 고요한 새벽하늘
부름이 울리면 단 오 분 만에 대지를 박차고

날아올라라, 푸른 창공을 지키는 은빛 날개여!
