창공을 넘어... 영원토록 빛나라!
tracks.lyrics_en:
In the quiet dawn sky, where all sleep in peace,
When the call rings out, in mere five minutes, we launch from the earth,
Like swift hawk wings painting the blue expanse,
Piercing clouds, we surge beyond the stratosphere.
So trees below may safely bear their fruit,
We are the ones who guard the sky's unseen borders.
Behind the tranquil days we take for granted,
There beat a fervent heart, cleaving the sky like a flame.
The engine's roar, like a heartbeat, shakes the heavens!
Rise above all fear, soar towards the sun!
Fly high, silver wings that guard the azure sky!
Because we stand watch, the world's morning is peaceful today!
Tear through dark storm clouds, race headlong to the light!
Our fervent anthem will echo to the sky's end!
Hey! Hey! Be the master of that boundless sky!
An unwavering gaze, even in tension like thorns,
The warm lights of the streets below, which we have kept safe,
Shine more beautifully than stars in the night sky.
So today, we gladly face the wind and take to the sky.
Fly high, silver wings that guard the azure sky!
Because we stand watch, the world's morning is peaceful today!
Tear through dark storm clouds, race headlong to the light!
Our fervent anthem will echo to the sky's end!
Soar even higher!
This sky, we shall defend!
Shine brilliantly, guardians who race above the clouds!
Adorn the heavens with pride that will never fade!
From the world's highest peak, we will sing of victory!
Beyond the boundless sky... shine on forevermore!

하늘 높이 날아올라... 바로 지금!
tracks.lyrics_en:
Even on white winter days when fierce blizzards rage,
Children forget the cold, piling snow to build their towers.
A heart that draws smiling faces on cold snowballs,
That pure innocence melts a frozen world.
Though time flows on and fewer hearts believe,
The will to gift someone a beautiful spirit,
Like an old grandfather's sleigh lifted high into the sky,
Our faith transforms miracles into reality.
Don't fold your wings just because you've grown up!
The innocence within us awakens the sky once more!
Soar high, with wings forged by a pure heart!
Even a blizzard-swept night sky can't stop our celebration!
That warm resolve, wishing for someone's happiness,
Will make us fly beyond the starlight, to the sky's very end!
Hey! Hey! Sing the song of miracles together!
Remember the dream you first drew on a white canvas,
Remember the dream you first drew on a white canvas.
A dazzling magic the world's calculations can't explain,
Small gifts and gentle smiles exchanged between us,
Tonight, they make us all soar high into the sky!
Soar high, with wings forged by a pure heart!
Even a blizzard-swept night sky can't stop our celebration!
That warm resolve, wishing for someone's happiness,
Will make us fly beyond the starlight, to the sky's very end!
You can fly as far as you believe!
Gift the world your beautiful heart!
Shine brilliantly, winter sky awakened by innocence!
Illuminate the world with warm dreams that will never fade!
Our anthem echoes throughout the entire sky!
Soar high... right now!

tracks.lyrics_kr:

모두 다 함께 두 팔을 벌려라!

tracks.lyrics_en:
Tonight, I'll be the world's most joyful jester,
And gladly dance a foolish jig before your eyes.
What others whisper, it means nothing, I don't care,
For all I see is your bright face, a shining prize!
Even the street's unfeeling wind begins to sway in time,
The moment your lips curve upward at my clumsy pantomime.
Then every star in the night sky bursts forth like fireworks bright,
Because you love me, I can smile again tonight!
Can you hear my fervent cry, for you and you alone?
Because you listen, my whole life becomes a festive zone!
Shout it out, this night's our anthem, loud and clear!
Until your dazzling smile lights up the world, my dear!
Let all pretense and rules be scattered to the wind!
This moment, as we laugh together, is the brightest miracle we'll find!
Hey! Hey! Hey! Laugh louder, let it ring!
If just one person, you, will lend an ear to my voice,
Then there's no fear, no hesitation, only joyous choice.
Let's match our steps to this heart-bursting rhythm's beat,
And sing this happiness until the morning sun we greet!
Shout it out, this night's our anthem, loud and clear!
Until your dazzling smile lights up the world, my dear!
Let all pretense and rules be scattered to the wind!
This moment, as we laugh together, is the brightest miracle we'll find!
You are smiling now!
My cries are reaching you!
Everyone, open your arms wide!
Everyone, open your arms wide!
Blaze brightly, oh, this festival for your sweet smile!
Fill the night with fervent joy that won't fade for a while!
Our laughter will resound throughout the boundless sky!
Your smile... it is my everything!

tracks.lyrics_kr:
차가운 말들로 굳게 닫혀 있던 세상의 문 앞에서

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Verse 1]
Before the world's door, tightly shut by icy words
While everyone, not knowing the code, stamped their feet in despair
A single golden key, sparkling in my pocket
It's the warm temperature of affection, warming every heart!

[Verse 2]
Even a small puppy welcomes only genuine affection
What moves human hearts isn't calculation, but fervent sincerity
With one kind word, frozen streets instantly melt away
All the walls that blocked us crumble down onto the stage!

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't hold back, pour out everything you have right now!
The miracle of growing bigger with every share begins!

[Chorus]
Throw it open, with the fervent key that unlocks happiness!
Tonight, our affection makes the whole world dance!
With the warmth of words burning deep within our hearts
Ignite the dazzling festival lights in the dark night sky!

[Bridge]
Hey! Hey! Hey! Share your love without reserve!
Tonight, the hottest night where no one is left out
A fervent word of cheer, exchanged as we meet each other's eyes
If you desire a happy life, don't hesitate, reach out your hand
Let's leap together into this immense wave of joy!

[Chorus]
Throw it open, with the fervent key that unlocks happiness!
Tonight, our affection makes the whole world dance!
With the warmth of words burning deep within our hearts
Ignite the dazzling festival lights in the dark night sky!

[Outro]
Raise the temperature even higher!
Love opens the door!
Let's all raise our voices together!
Explode brilliantly, our fervent sincerity!
Sing high the anthem of happiness that will never cease!
The whole world fills with our passion!
The key to happiness... it's right here in our hands!

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Verse 1]
Even the white bear of the cold Arctic, braves the bitter winter's might,
And tiny sprouts beneath the earth, reach for the sun's warm light.
Like vibrant fruits within a cup, so clear and bright,
Our love, too, sparkles anew, with ever-changing light!

[Pre-Chorus]
The energy that wakes the dullest day, in one swift, vibrant burst,
The only power that makes my feet, once still, now run the fastest first,
No grand reason or explanation, is needed to be heard,
What makes me live and breathe, is only love for you, my cherished word!

[Chorus]
The cold season has retreated, far behind us now it lies!
Towards the sun, throw open wide, your arms to touch the skies!
Sing out! What moves us, what truly moves us, is only love's sweet call!
Love, and again love, makes the whole wide world stand tall!

[Post-Chorus]

[Outro]

tracks.lyrics_en:
All people dream of utopias far away,
Lost on paths, not knowing how to live each day.
But in the alley, weary from the world's harsh end,
I saw your warm eyes, waiting there for me.
That I am so lacking, so incomplete a soul,
My own heart knows this truth more than all.
Yet you, without a word, embraced and loved even me,
Your embrace became another world, a heaven to me.
No need to strive for happiness far away,
Now I know the one person I must protect.
At the journey's end, your warmth welcomes me!
Though the world may crumble, I am no longer afraid!
If true happiness is what you seek, it starts with you beside me,
I'll make you happy with all my life's embrace!
Oh-oh-oh- to your side, you who became my sky!
The words that loving each other, we'd fear nothing at all,
I finally realized the moment I held your warm hand.
The only secret of happiness held in my mind,
Is just the smile spreading on your face tonight.
At the journey's end, your warmth welcomes me!
Though the world may crumble, I am no longer afraid!
If true happiness is what you seek, it starts with you beside me,
I'll make you happy with all my life's embrace!
No matter what trials may block our way,
I will never let go of your hand by my side.
Oh, you who embraced my lacking self with love!
Oh, you who embraced my lacking self with love!
Your side is truly the heaven I dreamed of!
Forever I'll protect your smile and sing your praise!
To you right beside me... I will stay forever...

tracks.lyrics_en:
Gathering each twig, you built a nest for me,
You split your days, though time was short, to raise me up.
When storms raged, you sheltered me beneath your wings,
From that warm embrace, I soared into the wide world.
A season I believed I could conquer the vast sky alone,
When fierce winds broke my wings, and I fell, weary and worn,
Without fail, your image shimmered, a vision in my mind,
Your back, always urging me to fly ahead, to lead the way.
A warmth I can't forget, no matter how far I roam,
Now I know whose spirit guides my flight across the sky.
Through stormy night skies, I fly back to your embrace!
The only haven where my wounded wings can find their rest!
You gave your all for me, even when time was scarce,
Your warm nest is the lifeblood that sustains me!
Oh-oh-oh – I'm flying back to your side once more!
Even today, thinking I'd left the nest, independent and free,
I look back and still follow the rhythm of your wings.
A place warmer than any grand castle in the world,
The love that raised me, it was everything in my life.
Through stormy night skies, I fly back to your embrace!
The only haven where my wounded wings can find their rest!
You gave your all for me, even when time was scarce,
Your warm nest is the lifeblood that sustains me!
Now I will spread my own wings, wider than before,
And shield your weary shoulders from the harsh winds.
My beloved, who taught me how to soar into the sky!
Within your embrace, I will sing of eternal peace!
Our warm sanctuary, forever stretching into eternity!
The path back home... to your warmest nest...

tracks.lyrics_en:
Like the deep Bermuda sea, where my compass died
Nights I wandered lost, adrift in a sea of tangled feelings
Awkward words, like crashing waves, tore at us both
Dark hours when every light inside me slowly died
When everyone denied my clumsy self and turned their backs
Only you, with warm affirmation, reached out and held my hand
Saying denial only brings forth more wounds
The only one who calmed the wild waves within me
When the fog lifts, a lighthouse gleams in the distance
Now I know the harbor where my small boat must finally land
Beyond the stormy sea of feelings, into your embrace!
Though fierce waves may crash, I am not afraid!
You embraced even my clumsy feelings with love
For where you are is my only salvation!
Ooh-ooh-ooh- to your side, shining like a lighthouse!
After practicing to let the rain fall, enduring the pain
After practicing to let the rain fall, enduring the pain
At last, a warm wind blows within my heart
Within your vast sea, where I can never be harmed
I finally drop anchor and breathe in peace
Beyond the stormy sea of feelings, into your embrace!
Though fierce waves may crash, I am not afraid!
You embraced even my clumsy feelings with love
For where you are is my only salvation!
Even if the dark sea shakes us once again
I'll sail to the end, guided only by your starlight
My beloved, who became my harbor!
Within your affirmation, all my wounds turn to light!
Forever by your side, I will sing of peace!
At the end of the lost sea... to your side, who saved me...

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Verse 1]
Swept away by the noise of a busy world
I must have forgotten the most precious truth for a while
Beyond countless screens and cold letters
My lonely, weary steps halted on that night

[Pre-Chorus]
Lovers sitting face to face, gazing into each other's eyes
An ancient instinct known without being taught
The one true home my soul remembered from the beginning
It was your deep eyes, looking back at me

[Chorus]
After long years, standing face to face again now
My forgotten heart cries out to you
In your eyes facing mine... forever by your side...
A warm light blooming in your eyes facing mine!
Even the cold winds of the world cannot tear us apart!
The only love my instinct knew from long ago
Because where you are is the home I will return to!
Oh-oh-oh- To your side, where I'll face you forever!

[Verse 2]
One deep gaze from you, more profound than a hundred ornate words
Melts my frozen day in an instant
That obvious yet great truth I briefly forgot
I will never let it go again

[Chorus]
A warm light blooming in your eyes facing mine!
Even the cold winds of the world cannot tear us apart!
The only love my instinct knew from long ago
Because where you are is the home I will return to!

[Bridge]
Even if time flows and all landscapes change
I will walk, gazing into your eyes, just like the first time
Oh, you who became the sanctuary of my soul!
Within your gaze, I will sing of eternal love!
Oh, our warm season that will endlessly continue!

[Outro]
In your eyes facing mine... forever by your side...
In your eyes facing mine... forever by your side...

tracks.lyrics_en:
A day began, alone you woke in the dim light of dawn
You ran, every nerve focused, as if cutting paper with care
Unaware of how the hours had slipped away
Now the evening glow settles on your heavy shoulders
More fiercely than any, you finished even yesterday's share
Let me embrace your stiff shoulders, your weary hands
For you, who silently bore the weight of a hard day
For you, who silently bore the weight of a hard day
You truly deserve comfort, a warmth to soothe your soul
Cast all your heavy burdens down in yesterday
Tonight, you may breathe easy, as if by magic's grace
I'll embrace you, home at last from your tiring day!
So the rough world's weight won't make you sway!
Your tired shoulders, having triumphed over yesterday's rush
Will find full rest within my arms, I promise you!
Oh-oh-oh – To my side, where I'll be your haven, your peace!
Like a gentle touch that breathes life into a tired soul
May my warm words gently soothe your night
All your busy work is done, so let no worries stay
Tonight, just lean on me, and close your eyes
I'll embrace you, home at last from your tiring day!
So the rough world's weight won't make you sway!
Your tired shoulders, having triumphed over yesterday's rush
Will find full rest within my arms, I promise you!
Should the world ever fail to know your name
I alone will always remember your hard work
My beloved, who bravely held on through this day!
You deserve more happiness than anyone alive!
I will be your most peaceful home, for all time!
Rest peacefully... here by my warmth...

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Verse 1]
A habit, to pause my steps and look up at the sky
White clouds drift with the wind, scattering then gathering anew
When the sun's too bright, and I gently shield my eyes
A small photograph remains, carried on the passing breeze

[Pre-Chorus]
A single light descends, warming the cold earth below
The wind shifts the clouds, letting green life bloom and grow

[Chorus]
Have you ever heard the song the sky and wind softly sing?
The quiet rhythm of nature, unknown when I was alone
In the lazy afternoon hours, where clouds gently drift by
Today, I hold your hand and quietly lend an ear

[Verse 2]
Just as clouds gather and then scatter, each with a reason
This path we found, turning back, must have been destiny
Above the silent shadows of two people walking side by side
The afternoon sunlight gently settles, warm and kind

[Chorus]
Have you ever heard the song the sky and wind softly sing?
The quiet rhythm of nature, unknown when I was alone
In the lazy afternoon hours, where clouds gently drift by
Today, I hold your hand and quietly lend an ear

[Bridge]
That song I couldn't hear when lost in thought alone
Now walking with you, it finally reaches my ear
Just as the wind embraces clouds and slowly drifts along
Let's follow the season's song, unhurried and strong
At the pace of this warm afternoon, as sunlight warms the ground
Let's just, walk together until this path's end is found

[Outro]
Listening to the song the sky and wind softly sing
Let us slowly walk along

tracks.lyrics_en:
My young heart, when first I saw the world's bright gleam,
Was a pure white canvas, an untouched, empty dream.
As my clumsy hands began to draw lines, crooked and unsure,
You sat beside me, choosing colors, gentle, warm, and pure.
So I could paint with love before I knew of hate,
A hand that sketched a beautiful outline for my fate.
The heart you drew with crayons on my canvas, pure and bright,
That tender blueprint helped me grow into the light.
Even on hard days, the colors within me never fade,
Because the love you painted in my youth has always stayed.
Within your wide embrace, my world grows beautiful and true.

In seasons that might have been gray, if I had walked alone,
You filled them with dandelions gold, and skies of azure tone.
That warmth, indelible, became my life's foundation, deep and vast.
The heart you drew with crayons on my canvas, pure and bright,
That tender blueprint helped me grow into the light.
Even on hard days, the colors within me never fade,
Because the love you painted in my youth has always stayed.
Within your wide embrace, my world grows beautiful and true.

Now I, too, wish to draw upon another's heart so white,
The warmest spring's first glow, a beacon of pure light.
Like afternoons of old, when crayon scents would softly bloom,
With a clear and gentle heart, I walk towards you through the gloom.
Like a sketch that time can never erase, though years may swiftly flee,
Today, your love remains the warmest comfort here for me.
You, who painted lovely pictures in my heart's soft space,
Your warm and tender touch, your gentle, kind embrace.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Verse 1]
In the kitchen of my youth, when little we possessed,
The sound of noodles boiling, white steam softly blessed.
No special side dish, yet it tasted so divine,
For Mother's loving smile was woven in each line.

[Pre-Chorus]
Though years have passed, and I can eat all things I crave,
On rainy afternoons, that humble bowl I still do crave.
As earnest heart poured in boiling water makes a broth so deep,
Even days of want, with love, warm memories will keep.

[Chorus]
For poverty or plenty, in our hearts the choice is made,
In one shared bowl of noodles, slurped with faces unafraid,
The world's most generous love, one size too large, does softly bloom.

[Verse 2]

As earnest heart poured in boiling water makes a broth so deep,

[Outro]
Like broth whose flavor deepens with the passing of the years,
Our table today is warmest, calming all our fears.
Rolling up memories, sharing them with grace,

tracks.lyrics_en:
As I gaze upon the dawn sky, where twilight softly descends,
Where all the world's clamor has fallen asleep, only quiet remains.
In this age of swift searches and even swifter forgetting,
I greet the morning slowly, like turning the pages of an old book.
Learning the warm sentiments that seep between the lines,
A time to fill the empty margins of my life, line by precious line.
With a heart that won't be quickly consumed, I sit beside you,
Rather than offering hasty comfort, we simply breathe as one.
With a warmth as deep and pure as the twilight dawn sky,
We, even today, without haste, write our own pages.
Like simple fare served on a humble breakfast table,
A person who, though not stimulating, never grows tiresome.
The morning sun, through the library window, embraces my shoulders.
With a heart that won't be quickly consumed, I sit beside you,
Rather than offering hasty comfort, we simply breathe as one.
With a warmth as deep and pure as the twilight dawn sky,
We, even today, without haste, write our own pages.
Even without rushing to conclusions, life quietly flows on,
Even without explanation, true love remains by our side.
As the dawn's quiet spreads into warm morning light,
Like setting a bookmark, I hold today's peace within my heart.
In this quiet time, as I sit beside you, greeting the day,
My day unfolds, boundlessly deep and peaceful.
What is warmer than comfort itself,
Is simply sitting here by your side.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Delicate grand piano notes with a warm solo cello]
[Verse 1]
In this diverse world, so many people
Live out their days, each on their own path.
Among countless faces that pass by,
We were just strangers before our names were called.
The day you gave me a small name, and called it so tenderly,
That's when we became inseparable, bound by affection.
[Pre-Chorus]
A tenderness conveyed, though survival isn't at stake,
Our hearts first meet in silent, gazing eyes.
[Chorus]
At the sound of my name, the one you call,
The world that felt so distant draws one step closer.
Among countless people, you gave me my own special name,
Are you a quiet angel who came into my life?
For when all time has passed, and our hands are empty, only people remain,
So today, I live on by the name you called me.
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Lyrical piano and warm string quartet melody]
[Verse 2]
Words can sometimes create misunderstandings and shadows,
But a heartfelt call becomes a song that melts the heart.
In the tender warmth conveyed heart-to-heart,
Like a mother's smile, who laughed even at mischievous pranks,
The voice of that one person who truly knows me
Builds a small home in the midst of this harsh world.
[Pre-Chorus]
When we simply accept each other, rather than striving to understand,
Those who truly connect are destined to stay by our side.
[Chorus]
At the sound of my name, the one you call,
The world that felt so distant draws one step closer.
Among countless people, you gave me my own special name,
Are you a quiet angel who came into my life?
For when all time has passed, and our hands are empty, only people remain,
So today, I live on by the name you called me.
[Bridge]
[Crescendo with warm drums and soaring orchestral strings]
Though seasons change and many things scatter away,
There's one echo that will never fade.
Life, in the end, is about leaving behind those we loved.
[Final Chorus]
[Full lush strings and emotional vocal climax]
Within my name, the one you call,
My humble days finally find their light.
Someday, far in the future, when our season begins to fade,
With that tender voice that first called me,
Please call my name once more, so warmly.
[Outro]
[Solo piano softly fading out]
The voice that brought me closer,
The name you call me by.
[End]

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Poignant grand piano arpeggios with a weeping solo violin and cello]
[Verse 1]
When I look down from the hill I climbed, breathless and steep,
My stifled heart opens up, clear and free in that moment.
But when I descend the hill and walk the alleyways,
The scenery that once seemed grand can sometimes appear so small,
Yet, when we step back and gaze upon our lives from afar,
We know they are painted in truly beautiful hues.
[Pre-Chorus]
If it's what your heart commands, then do not hesitate,
For all the footsteps we've taken have gathered to form today's hill.
[Chorus]
Our seasons, so beautiful when viewed from afar,
Our seasons, so beautiful when viewed from afar,
Even yesterday's moments, which up close seemed scarred and torn,
From the hilltop, looking down, become a shining landscape.
Though all beginnings may be alike, each ending is unique,
How we loved our time is what truly speaks of who we are.
May you remain by my side, just as you are, as time flows on.
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Soaring cello and piano duet with lush chamber strings]
[Verse 2]
Watching the clock's second hand, even a minute feels so long,
And the path I walk, my legs ache, making it seem so far,
But as I quietly count the landscapes passing by the window,
I learn that no days, once gone, were ever truly lost.
When the bells ring out at the year's end,
Just as people leave to see the red sunset on the West Sea coast,
[Pre-Chorus]
As the setting sun leaves behind its most fervent glow,
May our final page also be remembered with warmth.
[Chorus]
Our seasons, so beautiful when viewed from afar,
Even yesterday's moments, which up close seemed scarred and torn,
From the hilltop, looking down, become a shining landscape.
From the hilltop, looking down, become a shining landscape.
Though all beginnings may be alike, each ending is unique,
How we loved our time is what truly speaks of who we are.
May you remain by my side, just as you are, as time flows on.
[Bridge]
[Dynamic orchestral crescendo with warm drums and bass]
Just as the sand beneath the slide protects a child,
Unseen love has caught us whenever we fell.
To all those moments for which I was grateful, I now send my regards.
[Final Chorus]
[Soaring emotional vocal climax with full orchestra and piano]
Our lives, so dazzlingly beautiful when viewed from afar,
Today's weariness, on tomorrow's hill, will become a cherished song.
At the hour when the West Sea's twilight dyes the ocean red,
At the end of the path my heart commands, I embrace you.
[Outro]
[Solo grand piano and cello fading into silence]
Life, viewed from afar, must be truly beautiful,
With you, who remains unchanged as time flows on.
[Fade Out]

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Delicate grand piano solo with warm cello harmonics]
[Verse 1]
In the morning sun, resting gently by the window pane,
Cool breezes and warm comfort softly intertwine.
Like learning to breathe carefully, entering water for the first time,
Our lives too have moments we must learn, one step at a time.
Though mistakes arrive in an instant, filling our minds with doubt,
As we learn to swim, we'll find ourselves better than yesterday, without a doubt.
[Pre-Chorus]
When you release the hands that struggled to conquer the tide,
A quiet moment comes, where you converse with the water, deep inside.
[Chorus]
Even your cold heart will warm if you let it move and sway,
Even on white snowfields, frozen for a thousand years, they say,
If you move your body with effort, hot sweat will soon flow free,
Don't stand still in fear, trembling, for all eternity.
If you surrender your body to the waves, and slowly match their breath,
The clearest bell will ring within your heart, conquering all death.
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Lyrical piano, acoustic guitar, and warm string quartet melody]
[Verse 2]
Like gathering your focus when cutting paper with a scissor's blade,
Let yesterday's busy, weary burdens in yesterday's shadows fade.
For being poor or rich has no bearing on true happiness,
Give thanks for a warm bowl of rice, freshly cooked, in blessedness.
If you quietly gaze upon the seasonal landscape before your eyes,
A beautiful echo will resound from where your deepest feelings rise.
[Pre-Chorus]
When you don't resist the fierce current, but embrace its flow,
The waves at last become the arms that lift you, letting your spirit grow.
[Chorus]
Even your cold heart will warm if you let it move and sway,
Even your cold heart will warm if you let it move and sway,
Even on white snowfields, frozen for a thousand years, they say,
If you move your body with effort, hot sweat will soon flow free,
Don't stand still in fear, trembling, for all eternity.
If you surrender your body to the waves, and slowly match their breath,
The clearest bell will ring within your heart, conquering all death.
[Bridge]
[Strings swelling with warm timpani and steady drum build-up]
The chilling winter wind, as you rode the lift so high,
Changes to a warm breeze the moment you race down the hill, beneath the sky.
A single small movement awakens the frozen season, standing still.
[Final Chorus]
[Soaring vocals with full chamber orchestra and grand piano]
Even your cold heart will warm if you let it move and sway,
Even your cold heart will warm if you let it move and sway,
Like the morning's greeting, as sunlight breaks upon the wave,
It's okay to make mistakes; just converse with the water, be brave,
And at the end of our season, a gentle bell will echo, soft and grave.
[Outro]
[Solo piano notes gently fading out]
Even a cold heart will warm if it moves and starts to sway,
On this morning, conversing with the water, come what may.
[End]

[End]

[Female] If only this one truth remains, that I am with you, my love

tracks.title_kr: 고구마 백 개에 사이다 한 모금
tracks.title_en: A Sip of Cider After a Hundred Sweet Potatoes
tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
오늘도 말이 통하지 않는 사람들 사이에서
퍽퍽한 고구마 백 개를 삼킨 듯 가슴이 막혀 와
당연한 이야기를 아무리 설명해 봐도
벽을 보고 말하는 것 같은 답답한 오후 세 시
인상 쓰던 내 앞에 네가 웃으며 걸어온다
[Verse 2]
투명한 유리컵에 얼음 두 조각을 띄우고
탄산수에 달콤한 설탕 한 스푼을 섞은 것처럼
[Chorus]
고구마 백 개를 먹은 듯 답답하던 하루 끝에
너는 내 가슴을 뻥 뚫어 주는 시원한 사이다 한 모금
톡 쏘는 기포처럼 머리끝까지 상쾌해져
한여름 무더위를 단숨에 날리는 차가운 팥빙수처럼
너와 마주 앉아 수다를 떨면 세상이 다 시원해진다
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and cheerful whistling]
[Verse 3]
새까만 눈화장처럼 속마음을 가린 사람들
무슨 생각을 하는지 도무지 알 수가 없지만
맑은 네 눈동자를 가만히 들여다보면
설명하지 않아도 내 마음을 다 알아주네
[Chorus]
고구마 백 개를 먹은 듯 답답하던 하루 끝에
너는 내 가슴을 뻥 뚫어 주는 시원한 사이다 한 모금
톡 쏘는 기포처럼 머리끝까지 상쾌해져
한여름 무더위를 단숨에 날리는 차가운 팥빙수처럼
너와 마주 앉아 수다를 떨면 세상이 다 시원해진다
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and bouncy acoustic guitar groove]
막혔던 속이 다 풀리면 저절로 나오는 감탄사
아 시원하다, 너는 내 인생 최고의 청량제야
[Final Chorus]
퍽퍽한 세상살이 목이 메어 올 때마다
퍽퍽한 세상살이 목이 메어 올 때마다
주머니 속 비밀처럼 꺼내 마시는 너라는 사이다
답답하던 구름은 바람에 다 날려 보내고
오늘도 너와 함께 시원한 웃음을 터뜨린다
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
아 시원하다, 사이다 한 모금
너와 함께라 참 상쾌한 오늘
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
Today again, among people whose words just don't connect
My chest feels choked, like swallowing a hundred dry sweet potatoes
No matter how much I explain what's obvious
It's a frustrating three PM, like talking to a wall
As I frowned, you walk towards me, smiling
[Verse 2]
In a clear glass, with two ice cubes floating
Like mixing a spoonful of sweet sugar into sparkling water
[Chorus]
At the end of a day, stifling like eating a hundred sweet potatoes
You are a cool sip of cider, bursting open my chest
Like sparkling bubbles, I feel refreshed from head to toe
Like cold patbingsu instantly chasing away summer's heat
When I sit across from you and chat, the whole world feels cool
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and cheerful whistling]
[Verse 3]
People who hide their true feelings, like dark eye makeup
I can never truly know what they're thinking
But when I quietly look into your clear eyes
You understand my heart, even without a word
[Chorus]
At the end of a day, stifling like eating a hundred sweet potatoes
You are a cool sip of cider, bursting open my chest
Like sparkling bubbles, I feel refreshed from head to toe
Like cold patbingsu instantly chasing away summer's heat
When I sit across from you and chat, the whole world feels cool
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and bouncy acoustic guitar groove]
When my blocked feelings are all released, an exclamation naturally escapes
Ah, so refreshing, you're the best refresher in my life
[Final Chorus]
Whenever this dry, choking life gets to me
Whenever this dry, choking life gets to me
You, like a cider I pull out and drink, a secret in my pocket
The stifling clouds are all blown away by the wind
Today, with you, I burst into refreshing laughter
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
Ah, so refreshing, a sip of cider
With you, today is truly invigorating

tracks.title_en: Lollipops and Sports Day Cotton Candy
tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
작은 막대 위에 알록달록 여러 가지 맛을 붙여 놓은
동그란 막대사탕 하나를 오랜만에 까 보았어
지금은 포장지 벗기기도 살짝 귀찮아졌지만
학창 시절엔 나쁜 습관을 끊어 보겠다고
주머니 가득 넣어 다니며 참 열심히도 물었었지
[Verse 2]
입안 가득 퍼지는 달콤한 과일 향기 속에
잊고 있던 그 시절 골목길이 선명하게 떠오른다
[Chorus]
그래요, 우리는 언제나 달콤한 추억을 먹고 살아요
운동회 날 교문 앞 하얗게 부풀어 오르던 솜사탕처럼
손에 쥐면 조금 끈적하고 긴 머리카락에 달라붙어
까르르 웃음 터지던 그날의 파란 하늘
인생에서 가장 달콤한 사탕은 결국 사랑이니까
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and whistling]
[Verse 3]
놀이터 미끄럼틀 아래 고운 모래가 가득 쌓여
다치지 않게 우리를 지켜 주던 엄마의 눈빛처럼
다정한 순간들이 차곡차곡 마음에 쌓여서
버릴 수 없는 평생의 보물 상자가 되었네
[Chorus]
그래요, 우리는 언제나 달콤한 추억을 먹고 살아요
운동회 날 교문 앞 하얗게 부풀어 오르던 솜사탕처럼
손에 쥐면 조금 끈적하고 긴 머리카락에 달라붙어
까르르 웃음 터지던 그날의 파란 하늘
인생에서 가장 달콤한 사탕은 결국 사랑이니까
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and acoustic guitar groove]
미끄럼틀에게도 안부 인사 한마디 건네고 싶은 날
입안에 굴리는 사탕 하나에 다시 열일곱 살이 된다
[Final Chorus]
막대사탕 하나에 피어나던 우리의 푸른 계절
하얀 구름을 닮은 솜사탕을 나눠 먹던 너와 나
세월이 흘러가도 입가에 번지는 이 달콤함으로
오늘 하루도 웃으며 신나게 걸어간다
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
우리는 추억을 먹고 살아요
우리는 추억을 먹고 살아요
사랑만큼 달콤한 사탕 하나
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
A colorful swirl of flavors on a tiny stick,
I unwrapped a round lollipop after so long.
Now, even peeling back the wrapper feels a slight chore,
But in school days, to break a bad habit,
I'd fill my pockets, biting into them so hard.
[Verse 2]
As sweet fruit scents fill my mouth,
The forgotten alleyways of that time clearly rise.
[Chorus]
Yes, we always live on sweet memories, you see,
Like cotton candy, white and fluffy, at the school gate on Sports Day.
A little sticky in our hands, clinging to long hair,
Under the blue sky where giggles burst forth.
For the sweetest candy in life, in the end, is love.
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and whistling]
[Verse 3]
Fine sand piled high beneath the playground slide,
Like a mother's gaze, keeping us safe from harm.
Tender moments gather, one by one, in my heart,
Becoming a lifelong treasure box I can't discard.
[Chorus]
Yes, we always live on sweet memories, you see,
Like cotton candy, white and fluffy, at the school gate on Sports Day.
A little sticky in our hands, clinging to long hair,
Under the blue sky where giggles burst forth.
For the sweetest candy in life, in the end, is love.
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and acoustic guitar groove]
A day I wish to greet the old slide once more,
With one candy rolling in my mouth, I'm seventeen again.
[Final Chorus]
Our youthful season, blooming with one lollipop,
You and I, sharing cotton candy like white clouds.
Though years may pass, with this sweetness on my lips,
I walk through this day, smiling and full of cheer.
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
We live on memories.
We live on memories.
One candy, sweet as love itself.
[End]

tracks.title_kr: 연두색 물감 하나 구하러 가는 날
tracks.title_en: Going Out to Find Light Green Paint
tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
내가 붓을 들어 그림을 그리면 늘 이상한 모양이 돼
정해진 방법대로 그리는 법을 잘 모르거든
그런데 아이들은 참 거침없이 그림을 잘도 그려
뭐가 이상한지 모르니까 마음 가는 대로 그리는 거야
세상 사람들의 평가가 어떻든 무슨 상관이람
[Verse 2]
결혼도 남의 말만 듣고 할 건 아니잖아
내가 바라보는 내 마음의 느낌이 제일 중요한 거지
[Chorus]
연두색 물감 하나 구하러 오늘은 밖으로 나가 볼까
놀이공원 바이킹을 타고 하늘 높이 올라간 것처럼
가슴이 뻥 뚫리는 스릴을 즐길 줄 아는 사람은
물감이 없어도 세상 가득 봄빛을 그릴 수 있지
내 맘대로 색칠하는 오늘 하루가 참 마음에 들어
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and cheerful whistling]
[Verse 3]
청룡열차처럼 오르락내리락 신나는 우리네 일상도
관람열차 창밖으로 천천히 스쳐 가는 풍경도
아는 만큼 보이고 느끼는 만큼 내 것이 되는 법
남들이 정해 놓은 밑그림에 나를 맞출 필요 없어
[Chorus]
연두색 물감 하나 구하러 오늘은 밖으로 나가 볼까
놀이공원 바이킹을 타고 하늘 높이 올라간 것처럼
가슴이 뻥 뚫리는 스릴을 즐길 줄 아는 사람은
물감이 없어도 세상 가득 봄빛을 그릴 수 있지
내 맘대로 색칠하는 오늘 하루가 참 마음에 들어
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and bouncy acoustic guitar groove]
곰이 벌집에서 달콤한 꿀을 가져오는 재빠른 지혜처럼
우리에게 필요한 행복은 내 손으로 직접 그려 가는 거야
[Final Chorus]
연두색 물감 하나 주머니에 넣고 휘파람을 불며
삐뚤빼뚤해도 세상에서 제일 유쾌한 나의 풍경화
누가 뭐라 해도 내가 좋으면 그게 바로 명작이지
싱그러운 봄바람을 타고 너에게 달려간다
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
연두색 물감 하나 구하러
가벼운 발걸음으로 나간다
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
When I lift my brush to paint, the shapes always turn out odd
I don't quite know how to draw by any set of rules
But children, they draw so freely, without a single care
They don't know what's strange, so they just draw from the heart
What does it matter what the world thinks, or what they have to say?
[Verse 2]
You wouldn't marry just by listening to what others might say
The feeling in my own heart, that's what matters most of all
[Chorus]
Shall I go out today to find a tube of light green paint?
Like riding a Viking ship, soaring high up to the sky
A person who knows how to enjoy that thrill, a breath of fresh air,
Can paint the world with spring's light, even without any paint
I truly love this day, coloring it just as I please
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and cheerful whistling]
[Verse 3]
Our exciting daily life, up and down like a roller coaster ride,
And the scenery slowly passing by the observation train's window,
You see as much as you know, it's yours as much as you feel
No need to fit myself into outlines others have drawn for me
[Chorus]
Shall I go out today to find a tube of light green paint?
Like riding a Viking ship, soaring high up to the sky
A person who knows how to enjoy that thrill, a breath of fresh air,
Can paint the world with spring's light, even without any paint
I truly love this day, coloring it just as I please
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and bouncy acoustic guitar groove]
Like the swift wisdom of a bear, bringing sweet honey from its hive,
The happiness we need, we draw it ourselves with our own hands
[Final Chorus]
With a tube of light green paint tucked into my pocket, I whistle a tune,
Though it's crooked, it's my landscape, the happiest in the world
No matter what they say, if I love it, then it's a masterpiece
Riding on the fresh spring breeze, I'm running to you now
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
To find a tube of light green paint,
With light steps, I head out the door
[End]

tracks.title_kr: 내 차만 주차 못 했어 (자전거 타던 날처럼)
tracks.title_en: Only My Car Couldn't Park (Like Bicycle Days)
tracks.lyrics_kr:

이 골목 저 골목 세 바퀴째 빙글빙글 돌고 있는데
다들 어쩜 그렇게 신기하게 자리를 잘도 찾았는지
오늘 밤도 이 넓은 동네에 내 차만 주차를 못 했네

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Bouncy acoustic guitar strumming and cheerful whistling melody]
[Verse 1]
As I turn into the alley on my way home, the silent battle begins.
How can every single space be filled, just cars, no room?
I'm circling, alley after alley, on my third weary round.
How did everyone else so magically manage to find their place?
Tonight, in this whole wide neighborhood, only my car can't park.
[Verse 2]
At times like these, I suddenly long for the city bus, stopping at every halt.
It's far more comfortable to be driven than to hold the wheel myself.
[Chorus]
In this alley where only my car can't park, a laugh escapes me.
I recall the day I first bought a bike, holding my parents' hands.
In those days, no worries of parking, no worries of gas.
Just pedaling with two feet, I'd ride anywhere, never tiring.
At the end of a complicated adult day, I try to whistle a tune.
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful acoustic guitar solo and whistling]
[Verse 3]
They say wisdom saves money, using things only when truly needed.
But tonight, I sometimes envy the snail, carrying its home on its back.
Still, with these strong legs, built from riding bikes as a child,
I can park far away, and walk back, watching the stars in the night sky.
[Chorus]
In this alley where only my car can't park, a laugh escapes me.
I recall the day I first bought a bike, holding my parents' hands.
In those days, no worries of parking, no worries of gas.
Just pedaling with two feet, I'd ride anywhere, never tiring.
At the end of a complicated adult day, I try to whistle a tune.
[Bridge]
[Handclaps and acoustic guitar groove]
What if I park a little far? I'll just take a walk, breathe in the night air.
A walk around the block, and all of today's weariness will fly away.
[Final Chorus]
Even if only my car couldn't park, my spirits are fresh tonight.
Like the bicycle boy of those days, roaming the alleys, never tiring.
With strong two legs, I walk home, moving to my own rhythm.
Because when I open the door, warm you will be there to greet me.
[Outro]
[Cheerful whistling and acoustic guitar fade out]
Only my car couldn't park.
But the path walking to you, it's a joyful one.

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Warm grand piano and gentle acoustic guitar arpeggio, slowly swelling with emotional cello]
[Verse 1]
A city of dazzling skyscrapers, unafraid of the night
Days I endured, guided by the fresh passion of my twenties
To live through a single day amidst so many people
We know well it was never an easy feat
Streets where money gathers, and grand dreams sparkle like lights
Wrapping tired shoulders, turning my steps homeward
[Verse 2]
When the world's excitement quiets, then I truly see people
Your fragrance spreads, even without elaborate adornment
Sitting across from you at our small table, softly sharing our day
A romance more dazzling than any grand stage in the world blossoms
I envy no one's magnificent castle, not even a little
[Pre-Chorus]
As the cold city lights fade behind my back
I see the one warm window waiting for me
[Chorus]
To your embrace, holding me at the end of the road home!
Even the harsh city winds cannot steal our romance!
Even if it's not a glamorous world, I envy nothing at all!
Because with you, we too dream beautiful dreams enough to live by!
Oh-oh-oh- My home where I'll rest forever, by your side!
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Soaring, weeping melodic electric guitar solo over full rock band and lush strings]
[Verse 3]
If we walk hand in hand to the places we longed to go
Every one of those footprints becomes a memory to sustain a lifetime
Even the weary daytime hours endured with passion and fervor
Become the sweetest rest with just one smile you offer
[Chorus]
To your embrace, holding me at the end of the road home!
Even the harsh city winds cannot steal our romance!
Even if it's not a glamorous world, I envy nothing at all!
Because with you, we too dream beautiful dreams enough to live by!
[Bridge]
[Piano and vocal building to a massive rock crescendo]
If there were no romance, how could we cross these long seasons?
The most fragrant person in the world, even without any adornment
You are everything I ever dreamed of
[Final Chorus]
My beloved, who became my romance!
In your two eyes, the starlight of my twenties shines again!
In our own sanctuary, unshaken even if the world crumbles
Forever with you, I will sing of fervent dreams!
[Outro]
I feel no envy... We too live, dreaming enough...
I feel no envy... We too live, dreaming enough...
[Warm piano and acoustic guitar slowly fading out]
[End]

꿈이 우릴 움직인다! (살아 있음을 느낀다!)

모두 다 함께 하늘을 향해 외쳐라!

찬란하게 타올라라, 어둠을 뚫고 피어난 빛이여!
사랑과 믿음으로 완성될 우리들의 위대한 시대!
영원히 꺼지지 않을 생명의 찬가를 높이 불러라!

꿈은 우릴 움직이게 하고... 살아 숨 쉬게 한다!

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Bright rhythmic rock piano chords building into an an explosive drum roll and soaring guitar lead at 128 BPM]
[Verse 1]
Through tunnels of long darkness, at last, the light breaks free,
A grand truth of this world, no one can deny!
In the heart of gray streets, where coldness had begun to creep,
I hear a sound that makes our stopped hearts leap!
[Verse 2]
The moment I embrace my flaws with a heart so pure and true,
The walls of fear crumble, and the right path breaks through.
Truth forever guides our eyes toward the sun's bright ray,
And burning faith saves us, even at despair's last day!
[Pre-Chorus]
Breathe warm life into this world, frozen and so cold!
Now, open wide your arms, behold tomorrow, brave and bold!
[Chorus]
Shout out loud, dreams make us breathe and thrive!
Shout to the world that our hearts are truly alive!
Over this cold era, let burning love and faith combine,
Let warm light overflow, making the whole world shine!
Hey! Hey! Hey! Go on without fear, until the very end!
[Guitar Solo]
[Blazing, joyful and melodic stadium rock electric guitar solo]
[Verse 3]
As our bodies grow, our spirits evolve higher each new day,
When we embrace each other, not calculating, but just the way,
Over the barren square, bright festival flames ignite,
For those with love and faith, there's no impossible sight!
[Chorus]
Shout out loud, dreams make us breathe and thrive!
Shout to the world that our hearts are truly alive!
Over this cold era, let burning love and faith combine,
Let warm light overflow, making the whole world shine!
[Bridge]
Dreams move us forward! (We feel so alive!)
Faith makes us stronger! (Warmth helps us thrive!)
All together, shout out to the sky!
[Final Chorus]
Burn so brightly, oh light that pierced the darkest night!
Our grand era, completed by love and by faith's might!
Sing high the hymn of life, a flame that will never die!
[Outro]
Dreams move us forward... and make us breathe alive!
[Grand piano and rock band explosive finish]
[End]

tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Soaring high-gain melodic guitar lead and fast driving rock drums at 126 BPM]

On the dark dawn sea, where furious waves crash and roar
When countless crossroads make everyone hold their breath
At every crucial turning point, we've steadfastly forged our path
Our burning hearts now echo towards the sky once more!
[Verse 2]
Though a fierce storm may block the ocean's way
A lighthouse of freedom and justice shines, piercing the distant dark
The values we've upheld become the reason our wings unfurl
Fearlessly, we ignite our engines above the raging strait!
[Pre-Chorus]
If we falter, the sea of destiny, impassable, lies before us!
Come, gather all your might and soar beyond the clouds!
[Chorus]
Fly high, oh wings that cross the rough strait in a single bound!
What we desire is a grand leap to awaken the world!
With the lighthouse of freedom, illuminating the dark sea, as our guide
Unfurl a safe route for tomorrow, to the very edge of the sky!
[Bridge]
Leap beyond the strait! (Soar even higher!)
The lighthouse's flame calls to us!
[Final Chorus]
Shine brilliantly, oh guardians who divide sea and sky!
The path we've chosen will soon become the new era's rule!
Above the highest firmament, we'll sing of victory's leap!
[Outro]
Beyond the rough strait... leap forevermore!
[Explosive arena rock band finish]
[End]

[Intro]
[Soaring high-gain melodic guitar lead and fast driving rock drums at 126 BPM]

나보다 더 소중한 가치를 마침내 발견한 순간!
[Verse 2]
스쳐 지나가는 바람 속에서 순간의 기회를 포착해

누구도 거스를 수 없는 대자연의 거대한 순리처럼

멈춰 서서 흔들릴 시간은 단 일 초도 없다!

[Chorus]
날아올라라, 고여 있지 않고 흐르는 강물처럼!

나보다 더 소중한 꿈을 심장 한가운데 품은 채
순간의 기회를 날개 삼아 성층권 너머로 질주해!
헤이! 헤이! 그 어느 때보다 찬란한 오늘이다!

닫혀 있던 뫼비우스의 고리를 과감히 끊어 버리고
맑게 깨어난 시선으로 저 넓은 수평선을 바라봐
우리가 흘린 정직한 땀방울이 시대의 강물이 되어
메마른 대지 위에 새로운 생명을 불어넣는다!
[Chorus]
날아올라라, 고여 있지 않고 흐르는 강물처럼!
오늘 우리가 맞이한 이 빛나는 시간에 감사하라!
나보다 더 소중한 꿈을 심장 한가운데 품은 채
순간의 기회를 날개 삼아 성층권 너머로 질주해!

기회를 놓치지 마라! (거침없이 흘러가라!)
우리의 시간이 가장 뜨겁게 빛난다!
[Final Chorus]
찬란하게 타올라라, 시대를 깨우는 맑은 폭풍이여!
영원히 멈추지 않을 생명의 흐름으로 하늘을 수놓아라!
가장 눈부신 창공 위에서 승리의 찬가를 노래하리라!

tracks.title_en: Fear Not the Unknown Night Sky
tracks.lyrics_kr:
[Intro]
[Atmospheric synth and soaring high-gain guitar lead bursting into a driving 124 BPM arena rock beat]
[Verse 1]
까만 밤하늘을 가로질러 떨어지는 별똥별을 보며
누구나 한 번쯤 가슴 깊은 소원을 빌어 보았지
태양이 거대한 중력으로 지구를 단단히 붙잡아 주듯
세상의 근원인 믿음은 결코 우리를 배신하지 않는다!
[Verse 2]
가보지 않은 미지의 하늘이 막연히 두려워 보여도
그 두려움은 그저 아직 마주하지 못했기 때문이야
구름을 뚫고 올라가 마주 선 진실의 하늘 위에서는
세상 모든 시련이 다 해볼 만한 도전으로 변한다!
[Pre-Chorus]
망설이던 시간은 끝났다, 이제는 시작해 봐도 좋아!
우리가 서 있는 이 순간이 새로운 출발선이다!
[Chorus]
날아올라라, 미지의 밤하늘을 조금도 두려워 마라!
정면으로 마주 선 순간 모든 것은 다 해볼 만하다!
태양의 중력처럼 흔들리지 않는 뜨거운 믿음으로
내가 살아가는 이 시간축을 내일의 역사로 만들어라!
헤이! 헤이! 별빛 너머 창공을 향해 질주하라!
[Guitar Solo]
[Soaring, emotional and heroic arena rock electric guitar solo]
[Verse 3]
저마다의 고유한 능력이 별빛처럼 빛나는 세상에서
통하는 사람들의 진심은 끝내 하늘에 남기 마련이지
오늘 우리가 내딛는 이 거침없는 발걸음 하나가
훗날 누군가 우러러볼 위대한 전통이 되리라!
[Chorus]
날아올라라, 미지의 밤하늘을 조금도 두려워 마라!
정면으로 마주 선 순간 모든 것은 다 해볼 만하다!
태양의 중력처럼 흔들리지 않는 뜨거운 믿음으로
내가 살아가는 이 시간축을 내일의 역사로 만들어라!
[Bridge]
믿음은 배신하지 않는다! (다 해볼 만한 세상이다!)
오늘의 비행이 내일의 역사가 된다!
[Final Chorus]
찬란하게 빛나라, 미지의 우주를 가르는 은빛 날개여!
두려움을 넘어선 자만이 가장 높은 별을 거머쥔다!
우리가 만들어 갈 위대한 시간축 위에서 영원히 노래하리라!
[Outro]
이제는 시작해 봐도 좋아... 창공의 역사가 되어라!
[Grand arena rock finish]
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Atmospheric synth and soaring high-gain guitar lead bursting into a driving 124 BPM arena rock beat]
[Verse 1]
Watching shooting stars streak across the dark night sky
Everyone, at least once, has wished a deep wish from their heart
Just as the sun's vast gravity holds the Earth so tight
Faith, the world's very source, will never betray our light!
[Verse 2]
Though unknown skies, untraveled, may vaguely fill us with dread
That fear is simply because we haven't faced them yet ahead
Above the sky of truth, where we rise through clouds to stand
Every trial in this world transforms into a challenge at hand!
[Pre-Chorus]
The time for hesitation is over, now it's fine to begin!
This very moment where we stand is a new starting line within!
[Chorus]
Soar high, fear not the unknown night sky, not even a trace!
The moment you face it head-on, everything's worth the chase!
With a burning faith, unwavering like the sun's strong pull
Turn this timeline I live upon into tomorrow's history, full!
Hey! Hey! Race towards the heavens beyond the starlight's gleam!
[Guitar Solo]
[Soaring, emotional and heroic arena rock electric guitar solo]
[Verse 3]
In a world where unique abilities shine like stars, each one bright
The true hearts of those who connect will surely remain in the sky's light
This single, bold step we take today, with courage so grand
Will someday become a great tradition someone will look up to and understand!
[Chorus]
Soar high, fear not the unknown night sky, not even a trace!
The moment you face it head-on, everything's worth the chase!
With a burning faith, unwavering like the sun's strong pull
Turn this timeline I live upon into tomorrow's history, full!
[Bridge]
Faith will not betray! (This world is worth trying everything for!)
Today's flight becomes tomorrow's lore!
[Final Chorus]
Shine brilliantly, silver wings that cleave the unknown universe!
Only those who conquer fear will grasp the highest star, diverse!
Upon the grand timeline we forge, forever we shall sing our verse!
[Outro]
Now it's fine to begin... become the history of the sky!
[Grand arena rock finish]
[End]

구름 너머 찬란한 번영의 시대를 활짝 열어젖혀라!

[Bridge]
두려움 없이 도전하라! (모든 경험이 내가 된다!)
백 년의 미래가 우리 눈앞에 펼쳐진다!

[Final Chorus]
찬란하게 빛나라, 새로운 시대를 설계하는 날개여!
돌을 철로 바꾸던 그 뜨거운 심장으로 하늘을 갈라라!
영원히 식지 않을 불꽃으로 창공의 정상을 노래하리라!

[Outro]
백 년의 하늘을 넘어... 끝없이 비상하라!
[Explosive arena rock band finish]
[End]
tracks.lyrics_en:
[Intro]
[Roaring high-gain electric guitar riff and fast driving stadium rock drums at 128 BPM]

[Verse 1]
In ancient nights, beneath the distant sky, a fervent flame first burned,
Like days when rough stone shards melted, transforming into iron firm,
Now a new cultural wind, unseen by any soul before,
Awakens with a mighty power, designing lives anew, forevermore!

[Verse 2]
If in your heart a burning dream still lingers, waiting to ignite,
No season could be more perfect than this very moment's light.
All days you faced the world, whether chosen or cast aside,
Are my own unyielding experience, my very self, where I reside!

[Pre-Chorus]
With two strong wings that sweet temptations cannot sway!
Ignite the engines, towards a hundred years of sky, today!

[Chorus]
Soar high, holding the revolutionary flame lit since ancient times!
A heart filled with purpose reawakens the vast, open climes!
With eyes that see a hundred years beyond yesterday's confine,
Throw open wide the brilliant age of prosperity, beyond the clouds that shine!
Hey! Hey! Now is the time to take flight and ascend!

[Guitar Solo]
[High-flying, heroic arena rock guitar solo with sweeping orchestral strings]

[Verse 3]
Do not hide within the shadows others have cast for you,
Share with the world the morning's awakening, fresh and new,
With fervent wingbeats, facing the fierce winds head-on, so bold,
Become the master of the new world we've dreamed of, stories yet untold!

[Chorus]
Soar high, holding the revolutionary flame lit since ancient times!
A heart filled with purpose reawakens the vast, open climes!
With eyes that see a hundred years beyond yesterday's confine,
Throw open wide the brilliant age of prosperity, beyond the clouds that shine!

[Bridge]
Challenge without fear! (Every experience becomes me!)
A hundred years of future unfolds for us to see!

[Final Chorus]
Shine brilliantly, oh wings that design a brand new age!
With that fervent heart that turned stone to iron, tear open the sky's page!
With a flame that will never cool, I'll sing of the zenith of the air!

[Outro]
Beyond a hundred years of sky... soar endlessly!
[Explosive arena rock band finish]
[End]
